guides.title: How to Enter Cheats in GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox
guides.description: The exact GTA 6 cheat input method for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, why cheats stay locked until the credits, and how to avoid failed inputs.
guides.h1: How to Enter Cheats in GTA 6 (PS5 and Xbox Series X|S)
guides.intro: GTA 6 brings cheats back, but it changes the rules. You type codes through your in-game phone, every cheat has its own unlock challenge, and nothing works until the main story is finished. This page walks through the input step by step.

p: Cheat entry works the same way on both consoles. Only the shoulder buttons you hold differ. The D-pad sequence itself is identical, so a code you learn on PS5 works on Xbox without changes.
list: Press **Up** on the D-pad during gameplay to take out the phone.
On PS5, hold **L1** and press **R1**. On Xbox Series X|S, hold **LB** and press **RB**.
Keep holding and enter the D-pad sequence for the cheat.
Watch for the on-screen confirmation that the cheat is active.

sections.h2: Why the Cheats list is empty at first
p: Every cheat is locked until the end credits roll. Once the story is done, the Cheats entry appears in the Progress menu and shows which cheats you have earned so far. Four cheats unlock with the story alone: $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and Cycle Weather. The other 57 each need their own challenge, such as 100 workouts or 25 gold shooting-range medals.

Most failed entries come from three habits. Releasing the shoulder buttons mid-sequence breaks the input, so hold them for the whole code. Miscounting repeated presses is the second, and Body Armor with its five Ups in a row is the usual culprit. The third is entering a code you have not unlocked yet. Check the [cheats database](/cheats/) or your Progress menu first so you know which inputs should work.

Activating a cheat disables saving, trophies and achievements for that session. Before experimenting, make a manual save in a separate slot so your clean progress stays untouched. Read [what cheats do to trophies and saves](/guides/gta-6-cheats-trophies-saving/) for the full picture.
If you are new to the layout, the [GTA 6 controls guide](/guides/gta-6-controls/) lists every default input for PS5 and Xbox, including the D-pad shortcuts that cheat entry relies on.

guides.title: GTA 6 Money Cheat: How to Get $250,000
guides.description: The GTA 6 $250,000 money cheat code, how to unlock it, how to enter it on PS5 and Xbox, and why you should use it on a separate save.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Money Cheat: $250,000 Code and How to Unlock It
guides.intro: GTA 6 has exactly one money cheat, and it pays out $250,000 at a time. It is one of the four cheats that unlock as soon as the story ends, so it is usually the first cheat players try.

p: Take out your phone with Up on the D-pad, hold L1 and press R1 on PS5 (LB and RB on Xbox), then enter **Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right**. The sequence is easy to remember as a full clockwise turn of the D-pad followed by a reversed, counter-clockwise one.
The only requirement is finishing the main story. There is no separate challenge for this cheat, unlike most of the other 60.

sections.h2: The catch: no saving, no trophies
p: Activating any cheat disables saving, trophies and achievements for that session. That makes the money cheat poor for long-term progress but useful for testing. Load a backup save, enter the code a few times, and try out the properties, vehicles or outfits you are weighing up. Once you know what you want, reload your clean save and earn the cash properly.

If the goal is completion, money from activities you need anyway is worth more than cheat cash you cannot save. Selling collectibles at pawn shops counts toward the Pixel Art cheat ($250,000 total), and selling vehicles counts toward Dark Mirror ($500,000 total). Track both totals in the [Tracker](/tracker/).

The cheat only arrives after the credits. For the 91 missions before that, see [how to make money fast in every chapter](/guides/gta-6-make-money-fast/), which covers car sales, jewelry stores and bank vaults.

faqs.q: Can I enter the money cheat more than once?
faqs.a: Each entry triggers the cheat again, but the session will not save, so the money disappears when you reload a clean save.

faqs.q: Is there an unlimited money cheat in GTA 6?
faqs.a: No. The only money cheat among the 61 gives $250,000 per use.

faqs.q: Does the money cheat work in GTA Online?
faqs.a: Cheats are a Story Mode feature.

guides.title: Do GTA 6 Cheats Disable Achievements, Trophies and Saving?
guides.description: What happens to saving, trophies and achievements when you use a GTA 6 cheat, plus a safe two-slot save routine that protects your progress.
guides.h1: Do GTA 6 Cheats Disable Trophies, Achievements and Saving?
guides.intro: Yes. Entering any cheat in GTA 6 disables saving, trophies and achievements for that session. The fix is simple: keep a clean save that cheats never touch.

p: Once a cheat is active you cannot save the game, and trophies on PS5 or achievements on Xbox will not pop. The restriction covers the whole session, not just the moment the cheat is active. Reloading a save from before you used the cheat restores normal behaviour.

list: Slot A is your real playthrough. Never enter a cheat while it is loaded.
Before experimenting, make a manual save in Slot B.
Load Slot B, use cheats freely, and quit without saving.
Reload Slot A to continue earning trophies.
p: This takes seconds and removes the risk of losing hours of progress by accident.

Some challenges overlap with trophies. Completing three collectible card sets earns the silver Don't Touch My Deck trophy, and 100% completion is tied to the A Long Road achievement. Finish those on your clean save before you lean on cheats. The [100% completion guide](/guides/gta-6-100-percent-completion/) lists what counts.

sections.h2: Cheats worth trying on a backup save
p: Once you have a backup slot, a few cheats are especially useful for testing. The $250,000 cheat lets you preview purchases before spending real money. Cycle Weather and, once unlocked, Pause Time of Day are ideal for screenshots. Attack Force and Vehicle Force are simply fun. None of these affect your clean save, as long as you quit without saving.

GTA 6 only autosaves when a mission ends, and it has no mission replay. The [saving guide](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/) explains manual saves and a slot routine that protects both trophies and missable content.

faqs.q: Does turning a cheat off restore trophies?
faqs.a: Reload a save from before you used the cheat to get trophies and saving back.

faqs.q: Do cheats affect my 100% completion?
faqs.a: They block saving in that session, so any progress made while cheating is lost when you reload. Do completion work on a clean save.

faqs.q: Do I lose unlocked cheats if I reload?
faqs.a: Cheat unlocks come from challenges you completed on your save, so they stay as long as that save had them.

guides.intro: The three ammo cheats in GTA 6 all come from shooting ranges. Each needs 25 medals at a different tier, and all three codes share the same first seven inputs.

list: **Max Ammo**: 25 medals at bronze or better.
**Infinite Ammo**: 25 medals at silver or better.
**No Reload**: 25 gold medals.
p: Because a better medal also counts for the lower tiers, every gold you earn pushes all three counters at once. Aim for gold from the start and you may unlock all three together.

All three start **Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Left, Up**. Max Ammo ends Up, Down, Left. Infinite Ammo ends Down, Down, Down. No Reload ends Down, Down, Up. A handy way to keep them apart: Infinite Ammo is the one that just keeps going down.

Shooting-range runs reward steady aim more than speed. Run the same range several times in a row so the target pattern becomes familiar, then move on. Log your medal counts in the [Tracker](/tracker/) after each session so you know which tier you are short on.

faqs.q: Do gold medals count toward Max Ammo?
faqs.a: Yes. Max Ammo accepts bronze or better, and Infinite Ammo accepts silver or better, so gold counts for both.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Infinite Ammo and No Reload?
faqs.a: Infinite Ammo means you never run out. No Reload also removes the need to reload.

guides.intro: Cocaine Flamingos are one of GTA 6's stranger collectibles. There are 125 hidden across Leonida, and you destroy them by shooting them.

p: Shoot a Cocaine Flamingo to destroy it and it drops cocaine packages. Each one destroyed adds to your total in the Progress menu.

list: **50 destroyed** unlocks the Inflatable Flamingo vehicle spawn cheat.
**100 destroyed** is the requirement for 100% completion reported by several guides.

p: Combine flamingo hunting with WAiNK scanning while you sweep each region. Update your count in the [Tracker](/tracker/) after each outing. The same counter powers the Inflatable Flamingo row in the [Cheat Unlock Planner](/calculators/).

The two milestones that matter are 50 and 100. Fifty destroyed is 40% of the full count and unlocks the Inflatable Flamingo. One hundred is 80% and is the reported 100% requirement. If you split the hunt across Leonida's six regions, roughly 17 per region gets you to 100. That is a planning target, not a claim about how flamingos are distributed.

Flamingos are easy to lose count of because they are destroyed rather than picked up. Tap the plus button in the [Tracker](/tracker/) right after each one, and check your total against the Progress menu at the end of a session.

guides.title: GTA 6 Underwater Discoveries: All 33 for 100%

guides.h1: GTA 6 Underwater Discoveries: All 33 and 100% Completion
guides.intro: There are 33 underwater discoveries in GTA 6, and unlike cards or flamingos, every single one is required for 100%.

p: Most collectibles in GTA 6 give you some slack for 100%. Underwater discoveries do not. All 33 are required, so they are worth tracking carefully.
The discoveries are linked to Kenton's treasure diving questline. Kenton appears in Chapter 1 through the Island Dreams mission, so the coastline around the Leonida Keys is a natural place to begin.
Take a boat out and anchor near a search area instead of swimming long distances from shore. Count each find in the [Tracker](/tracker/) as soon as you surface.

Most 100% lists let you skip a few entries. This one does not, which makes it the list most likely to leave you stuck at 99%. Treat it as the first collectible to finish rather than the last. A single missing discovery is far harder to find once you have forgotten which areas you have already searched.

Use the counter in the [Tracker](/tracker/) for the total, and tick off each region in the Regions list once you are confident you have searched its waters. If your count stalls short of 33, the unticked regions tell you where to look again. The [100% gap check](/calculators/) flags this requirement until it reads 33 of 33.

faqs.q: How many underwater discoveries are in GTA 6?
Do I need all of them for 100%?

faqs.q: How many watches unlock Pause Time of Day?
Do the time cheats have known codes?

guides.title: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist and Requirements

guides.h1: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist
guides.intro: Reaching 100% in GTA 6 means finishing the story and then working through the Collections and Activities pages of the Progress menu. Some lists need every entry, others leave you some slack.

p: Pause, open the Map, switch to the Progress tab and choose Collections. The Progress tab holds 12 cards in total; see the [Progress menu guide](/guides/gta-6-progress-menu/) for what each one shows.

list: Finish the main story first. 100% tracking opens after it.
Complete 15 of the 18 collectible card sets.
Find all 33 underwater discoveries.
Find 30 of the 34 magazines, books, comics and book swaps.
Destroy 100 of the 125 Cocaine Flamingos (reported by several guides).
p: Reaching 100% earns the A Long Road achievement.

Do the strict lists first, since you cannot skip any of them. Underwater discoveries come first. Then finish the smallest card sets and leave the 36-card sets for last. Finally, sweep flamingos and reads while exploring each region. The [Tracker](/tracker/) and the [100% gap calculator](/calculators/) show exactly what is left.

100% completion earns the Gold trophy A Long Road, one of 55 in the [GTA 6 trophy list](/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/). A small amount of content can be locked out for good, mostly in Chapter 1, so check the [missables guide](/guides/gta-6-missables/) before you move on.

faqs.q: Do I need every collectible for 100% in GTA 6?
faqs.a: No. Several lists leave slack, such as 15 of 18 card sets. Underwater discoveries are an exception: all 33 are needed.

faqs.q: Can I start 100% before the story ends?
faqs.a: You can collect along the way, but 100% tracking opens after the story.

faqs.q: What is the 100% achievement called?
faqs.a: A Long Road.

guides.title: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Missions: All 22 in Order (Just Like Paradise)
guides.description: All 22 GTA 6 Chapter 1 story missions in order, from Prologue to Discharge Time, with the shops and features each one unlocks. Spoiler-light.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Missions: Just Like Paradise (All 22 in Order)
guides.intro: Chapter 1 of GTA 6, Just Like Paradise, runs for 22 main story missions set around the Leonida Keys. It introduces most of the systems you will use for the rest of the game. This list stays spoiler-light: names and unlocks only.

list: **Gear Up** unlocks gun shops and loadout management.

**Unwanted Attention** unlocks Pay 'n' Spray shops and the cop scanner.
**Buck Me** sets up your bank account.
p: The Prologue is played as Lucia, and Gone Fishing then switches to Jason. **Tourist Trap** is the point of no return: once you start it, Chapter 1-only content is gone, including Shirley's two errands and Lucia's balcony meditation.
Chapter 1 is the best time to note activities you want to come back to. Gun shops open after Gear Up, and Pay 'n' Spray after Unwanted Attention, so wanted-level escapes get easier from that point.

Chapter 1 holds 22 of GTA 6's 91 story missions, about a quarter of the main story. Four of those 22 open systems you will use all game: gun shops, the lockup drop-off, Pay 'n' Spray with the cop scanner, and your bank account.

Some content exists only in Chapter 1. Work through the [Chapter 1 checklist](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-checklist/) and the [missables guide](/guides/gta-6-missables/) before Tourist Trap, and read the [beginner tips](/guides/gta-6-beginner-tips/) if you are still in your first hours.

faqs.q: How many missions are in GTA 6 Chapter 1?
faqs.a: 22 main story missions, from Prologue to Discharge Time.

faqs.q: Who do you play as first?

faqs.q: When do Pay 'n' Spray shops unlock?

guides.h1: GTA 6 Chapter 2 Missions: Paradise Lost (All 11 in Order)
guides.intro: Chapter 2, Paradise Lost, has 11 main story missions and is centred on Port Gellhorn. It is the shortest of the first four chapters, but it unlocks several systems you will use for the rest of the game.

list: **Moses** unlocks car registration and selling at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, plus the Scooter Bros app for calling your cars.
**Daily Driver** leads to the Vice City Real Estate app, where you can buy garages.
**Breakfast Run** unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia. Hold Right on the D-pad and press R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox.
p: Two missions that show up during this chapter, **Thrillbillies** and **Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab**, are optional. They belong to Billy's side strand at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, which continues with Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.

If you want to keep Chapter 1 side content tidy, now is a good moment to log your collectible counts in the Tracker. Chapter 2 opens up more of the map, and it is easy to lose track once you spread out.
Mission names are blurred in the [Tracker](/tracker/) until you tap them, so you can tick progress without reading ahead. On this page they are shown in full.

Finishing Paradise Lost brings you to 33 of the 91 story missions, a little over a third of the way through the main story. If you track side content as you go, this is a natural point to check your counters against the Progress menu and correct anything you missed.

sections.h2: Keep a clean save before moving on
p: Make a manual save in a separate slot at the end of Chapter 2. It gives you a safe point to return to if you later want to replay a section, and it is good practice for the cheats phase after the credits, when you will want a save that cheats never touch. More in [cheats, trophies and saving](/guides/gta-6-cheats-trophies-saving/).

faqs.q: How many missions are in GTA 6 Chapter 2?
faqs.a: 11 main story missions. Thrillbillies and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab also appear in this chapter, but they are optional missions for Billy.

faqs.q: What is the last mission of Chapter 2?
faqs.a: Checking Out.

faqs.a: Five.

guides.title: How Many Missions Are in GTA 6? Chapters Explained
guides.description: GTA 6 has 91 main story missions across five chapters: 22, 11, 26, 25 and 7. Chapter names, counts and what each chapter unlocks.
guides.h1: How Many Missions Are in GTA 6?
guides.intro: GTA 6's main story has 91 missions split across five chapters, following Jason and Lucia from the Leonida Keys to Vice City and beyond.

list: **Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise** (22 missions, Leonida Keys)
**Chapter 2: Paradise Lost** (11 missions, Port Gellhorn)
**Chapter 3** (26 missions), where the story reaches Vice City
**Chapter 4: Vice City, Baby** (25 missions)
**Chapter 5: Top of the World, Ma** (7 missions)
p: That adds up to 91. Chapters 1 and 2 together account for 33 missions, and Chapters 3 and 4 hold more than half of the story with 51 between them.

Counts differ between outlets. The 91 total and the 22, 11, 26, 25 and 7 split match the mission lists on two large gaming sites. Some walkthroughs list more than 100 entries, and one database numbers 109, because they appear to count shorter story tasks as separate missions.
Finishing all 91 is what unlocks the Cheats list. Four cheats become available immediately: $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and Cycle Weather.
The [Tracker](/tracker/) lists Chapters 1 and 2 mission by mission, with names hidden until you tap them, plus a single milestone for finishing the story.

Several core systems arrive through early story missions. Gear Up opens gun shops and loadout management. Lab Fees introduces the Brian's Lockup drop-off. Unwanted Attention adds Pay 'n' Spray shops and the cop scanner, and Buck Me sets up your bank account. The [Chapter 1 guide](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-missions/) lists all 22 missions in order.

With 91 missions in total, finishing Chapter 1 puts you about 24% through the main story (22 of 91), and finishing Chapter 2 about 36% (33 of 91). Chapter 3 takes you to 59 of 91 (65%) and Chapter 4 to 84 of 91 (92%), leaving a short seven-mission final chapter.

sections.h2: Why later chapters are not listed mission by mission
p: Mission names past Chapter 2 give away major story beats, and early community lists still disagree on their order. Rather than publish a list that might be wrong, the Tracker uses a single milestone for finishing the story. That is also the checkbox that unlocks the cheat rows in the [Cheat Unlock Planner](/calculators/).

faqs.q: How many story missions does GTA 6 have?
faqs.a: 91 main story missions on the most common count. Some walkthroughs list more than 100 because they split the story into smaller tasks.

faqs.q: How many chapters are in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Five.

faqs.q: What does finishing the story unlock?
faqs.a: The Cheats list in the Progress menu and four story cheats.

guides.h1: GTA 6 Release Date, Platforms and PC Version
guides.intro: GTA 6 launched on Thursday, 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, after two delays from its original autumn 2025 window.

p: Rockstar first targeted autumn 2025, then moved to 26 May 2026, then announced in November 2025 that the game would arrive on 19 November 2026. That date held.

Not at launch. GTA 6 is on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only, and Rockstar has not announced a PC release date. Past Rockstar games reached PC after console, but nothing is confirmed for GTA 6.

p: Because GTA 6 is console-only for now, every cheat in the game uses the same D-pad sequence on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Only the shoulder buttons you hold change: L1 and R1 on PS5, LB and RB on Xbox. Trophies and achievements follow the same rule on both: using a cheat switches them off for that session. See [how to enter cheats](/guides/how-to-enter-cheats-gta-6/) for the full input.

Most of the long-tail goals in GTA 6, such as 100 workouts, 100 fish or 125 Cocaine Flamingos, are easier when counted from day one than reconstructed later. Start a [Tracker](/tracker/) save in your first session, play the story at your own pace, and log counters as you go. Challenges are grouped into eight tracks: survival, combat, fitness, shopping, exploration, vehicle, sports and criminal. Every track pays out twice. Five completed challenges unlock one vehicle spawn cheat, and finishing the whole track unlocks a second. guides.title: GTA 6 Stunt Jumps and the Unlimited Nitrous Cheat
guides.description: Completing 50 stunt jumps in GTA 6 unlocks Unlimited Nitrous and Fuel. How to track jumps and pair them with other driving goals.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Stunt Jumps: 50 for Unlimited Nitrous and Fuel
guides.intro: Stunt jumps are back in GTA 6, and they come with a reward: 50 completed jumps unlock the Unlimited Nitrous and Fuel cheat.

p: Unlimited Nitrous and Fuel means neither runs out on your vehicles. It is a player cheat, and its code is Right, Down, Down, Right, Down, Right, Right, Left.
Log each completed jump on the stunt-jumps counter in the [Tracker](/tracker/). Recounting from memory after a long session is where most players lose track.
Stunt-jump runs pair naturally with vehicle challenges, which unlock the Lapwing Mallard at five and the Progen Emerus when the track is finished.

Stunt jumps reward a straight, committed approach. Line up with the ramp from further back than feels necessary, hold your speed steady rather than braking at the lip, and pick a vehicle with good top speed and stable handling. A motorbike or a light sports car is usually easier to control in the air than a heavy SUV.

The 50 on the Tracker counter is the number needed for Unlimited Nitrous and Fuel. The total number of stunt jumps in Leonida has not been confirmed here yet, so treat 50 as a milestone rather than the full count.

guides.intro: Girlypop Vehicles are a discovery collectible in GTA 6. Find all 16 and you unlock the Neon Jungle screen filter cheat.

guides.description: Catch 100 fish for Fisheye and complete 50 meditations for Fast Forward in GTA 6. Meditation spots, pacing tips and tracking.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Fishing and Meditation: Unlocking Fisheye and Fast Forward
guides.intro: Two of GTA 6's calmest activities hide two filter cheats. Catching 100 fish unlocks Fisheye, and completing 50 meditations unlocks Fast Forward.

p: There are 18 meditations to complete in Leonida. The two most detailed guides count 10 locations, and most of them count twice because Jason and Lucia can each meditate there. Fisheye needs 100 fish. Fishing works well as a break between story chapters, and a few catches at a time add up quickly.
The [Tracker](/tracker/) has separate counters for meditation spots found, meditations completed and fish caught.

Fifty meditations across 18 spots works out to about three visits per spot if you rotate through all of them, or many more visits to the two or three spots nearest where you usually play. For fishing, catching five fish per session gets you to 100 in 20 sessions. Plug your own numbers into the [play-time estimator](/calculators/) to see how long either goal will take.

sections.h2: Why these two are good filler
p: Both goals are low-pressure and can be done in short bursts between missions, so they suit sessions when you only have a few minutes. The rewards are screen filters rather than gameplay changes, which makes them worth unlocking for photo mode once the bigger goals are done.

faqs.q: How many meditation spots are in GTA 6?
faqs.a: 18 meditations across 10 locations, according to the two most detailed guides. They report that 15 of the 18 count for 100%.

faqs.q: How many fish unlock Fisheye?
Can I repeat meditations?
faqs.a: Yes. Fast Forward counts 50 meditations, more than the 18 spots.

faqs.q: What are the Fisheye and Fast Forward codes?
faqs.a: Both start Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left. Fisheye then ends Left, Up and Fast Forward ends Down, Left.

guides.title: GTA 6 Cheats Not Working? 7 Fixes to Try
guides.description: GTA 6 cheat code not working on PS5 or Xbox? Check these seven causes: story lock, unlock challenges, input mistakes and look-alike codes.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Cheats Not Working? Seven Causes and How to Fix Each One
guides.intro: If a GTA 6 cheat code does nothing when you enter it, the game is almost never broken. In nearly every case one of seven things is going on, and most take seconds to check. Work through them in order.

sections.h2: 1. You have not finished the story
p: This is the most common cause. Every cheat in GTA 6 stays locked until the main story is complete. Until the credits roll, the Cheats list in the Progress menu is not available and no code will register, no matter how accurately you enter it. If you are partway through the 91 missions, cheats are simply not available yet.

sections.h2: 2. That cheat's own challenge is not done
p: Finishing the story unlocks only four cheats: $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and Cycle Weather. Each of the other 57 has its own challenge. Body Armor needs 100 workouts, Max Ammo needs 25 shooting-range medals, and so on. Open the Progress menu and choose Cheats to see which ones you have actually earned. If the cheat is not listed as unlocked, its code will not work. The [cheats database](/cheats/) shows every requirement, and the [Cheat Unlock Planner](/calculators/) shows how far you are from each.
Codes are entered through the in-game phone. Press **Up** on the D-pad first to bring it out. If you press the arrows without the phone out, the game reads them as normal controls, not as a cheat.

sections.h2: 4. You let go of the shoulder buttons
p: On PS5, hold **L1** and press **R1**. On Xbox, hold **LB** and press **RB**. Then keep holding while you enter the whole D-pad sequence. Releasing early cancels the input. If your hand position makes that awkward, rest the controller on your lap and use your other hand's thumb for the D-pad.

Several codes repeat a direction. Body Armor has five Ups in a row. Infinite Ammo ends with three Downs. Unlimited Focus is nine Down and Up presses before a final Right. Tap in a steady rhythm and count out loud. Rushing is how one press gets dropped or doubled.

Many GTA 6 codes differ by a single press. Raise Heat Level and Raise Wanted Level are identical except for the sixth input. Infinite Ammo and No Reload differ only on the last press. The MTL Pumper and HVY Bulldozer also differ only at the end. If a different cheat activates, or nothing does, compare your input with its sibling in the table below.

sections.h2: 7. Your list has a wrong code
p: Not every list online agrees. During launch week a few pages printed slips, such as an extra press on Cycle Weather or a different Vehicle Force sequence. If a code from elsewhere fails, compare it with the [cheats database](/cheats/), which now lists all 61. A code is listed on this site only when at least two separate sources print the identical sequence. The last 34 were added on 28 November 2026 and are re-checked on every update.

Restart the game and try the easiest code first: $250,000 (Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right). If that works, your input method is fine and the issue is the specific cheat's unlock. Remember that cheats disable saving and trophies for the session, so test on a backup save.

guides.h1: The Easiest GTA 6 Cheats to Unlock First
guides.intro: GTA 6 makes you earn its 61 cheats, but they are far from equally hard. Some arrive the moment the credits roll, some need one discovery, and some need a counter of just 20 or 25. Here is where to start if you want cheats quickly.

p: Four cheats need nothing but the end credits: **$250,000**, **Unlimited Focus**, **Attack Force** and **Cycle Weather**. All four have confirmed codes, so you can use them the moment the story ends. If you only ever use four cheats, these are the ones. One note on Cycle Weather: most guides list it as a story unlock, but a few say you must reveal the whole map, so sources differ.

Five cheats unlock from a single discovery rather than a grind. The **MTL Pumper**, **HVY Bulldozer** and **Interstate Ambulance** unlock once you discover the vehicle and it appears in the Progress menu. **Cataclysm** unlocks when you discover Martha's Vamos, and **Yesteryear** when you discover the Ridgeway. That makes them the best value in the game: one find, one working cheat.

Next come challenges with low targets. **Exploding Balls** needs 20 enemies hit with explosive damage. **No Fall Damage** needs 20 survived falls of 40 feet or more. **Vehicle Force** needs 25 vehicle kills, and **Raise Heat Level** needs 25 escapes from a three-star wanted level. Each of the eight challenge tracks also hands over a vehicle spawn at just five completed challenges, including the **Maibatsu Boomazoom**.

A few cheats only need time with your partner. **Golden Hour** needs four hours holding hands and **Dollhouse** eight hours together. Neither asks for skill. They build up as you play, especially if you bring your partner along for everything else.

The slow ones are the 100-count grinds (workouts, fish, grenades, Molotovs, stolen police vehicles), the full challenge tracks, and anything needing every collectible in a set. Start their counters early in the [Tracker](/tracker/), but do not wait on them.

guides.intro: Many GTA 6 cheat challenges share a counter or feed each other. If you plan around that overlap, one stretch of play unlocks two or three cheats instead of one. This order is built from the unlock requirements themselves.

p: Nothing unlocks before the credits, so the story comes first. It immediately gives you $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and Cycle Weather.

Explosive damage has a two-stage counter. Twenty enemies hit unlocks **Exploding Balls**, and 100 unlocks the **Explosive Shotgun**. While you are at it, throw grenades (100 for **All Explosive Weapons**) and Molotovs (100 for **Exploding Bottles**). Molotovs also burn enemies, which pushes the 100 fire-damage counter for **Incendiary Ammo**. Blowing up vehicles in the same sessions counts toward the 100 needed for the **Hauners H-AT**. That is up to six cheats from one style of play.

Escaping a three-star wanted level counts twice: 25 escapes for **Raise Heat Level** and 50 for **Raise Wanted Level**. Steal police vehicles during these chases and you also work toward the 100 needed for **Hellscape**. Vehicle kills during chases count toward the 25 for **Vehicle Force**.

Aim for gold from the start. A gold medal also counts as silver-or-better and bronze-or-better, so 25 golds unlock **Max Ammo**, **Infinite Ammo** and **No Reload** together. All three codes are known.

Take your partner on store robberies (50 for **Faded Glory**), gang operations (25 for **Pinhole**) and activities (50 for **Videotape**). Time together builds toward **Dollhouse** at eight hours, and walking hand in hand builds **Golden Hour** at four.

Watches unlock **Move Time Forward** at 10 and **Pause Time of Day** at 20. Cocaine Flamingos unlock the **Inflatable Flamingo** at 50 and count toward 100% at 100. The Vice City Flamingos card set unlocks **Bubblegum** and counts as one of the 15 sets needed for 100%.

Each of the eight tracks gives a vehicle at five challenges and a second for the full track. Take every track to five first for eight quick vehicles, then finish tracks one at a time. Completing all of them unlocks the Hauners P-996 Lazer.

guides.title: How to Memorise GTA 6 Cheat Codes: The Patterns
guides.description: GTA 6 cheat codes follow patterns. Learn a handful of shared openers and a few shapes, and you can remember all 61 codes without a list.
guides.h1: How to Memorise GTA 6 Cheat Codes Using Their Patterns
guides.intro: GTA 6's D-pad codes look random until you line them up. Cheats in the same family share the same opening inputs and change only at the end. Learn a handful of openers and a couple of shapes, and all 61 codes become easy to keep in your head.

p: Max Ammo, Infinite Ammo and No Reload all begin **Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Left, Up**. Only the last three presses change. Max Ammo ends Up, Down, Left. Infinite Ammo ends Down, Down, Down. No Reload ends Down, Down, Up. Memory hook: Infinite keeps going down forever, and No Reload bounces back up.
Incendiary Ammo and the Explosive Shotgun use a cousin of that opener: **Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Down, Up, Right, Down**. The last press is Down for Incendiary Ammo and Left for the shotgun.

Attack Force, Exploding Balls and Vehicle Force all begin **Down, Up, Left, Left, Right, Down**. Attack Force ends Down, Up, Down. Exploding Balls is the same but its final press is Right. Vehicle Force swaps the seventh press to Left, giving Left, Up, Down.
Exploding Bottles belongs to the same family. It ends Down, Up, Left.

Every vehicle spawn begins **Left, Up, Right, Down, Left**, a clockwise circle that closes back on Left. Three more presses pick the vehicle, so all 21 codes are eight inputs long. The Boomazoom ends Left, Up, Left. The MTL Pumper ends Right, Right, Up, the HVY Bulldozer Right, Right, Down and the Interstate Ambulance Right, Right, Right. Memory hook: Up for the Pumper, Down for the Bulldozer, like a blade dropping to the ground, and straight on for the Ambulance. The Lapwing Mallard ends Up, Up, Up and the Speeder 700 GT ends Down, Up, Up. The table below has the other 15 endings.

All 16 screen filters begin **Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left**. Only the final two presses differ, and the 16 filters use every possible pair once. Endings that start with Up: Golden Hour (Up, Up), Powdered Sugar (Up, Right), Pinhole (Up, Down), Neon Jungle (Up, Left). Endings that start with Right: Yesteryear (Right, Up), Cataclysm (Right, Right), Videotape (Right, Down), Dark Mirror (Right, Left). Endings that start with Down: Migraine (Down, Up), Dollhouse (Down, Right), Bubblegum (Down, Down), Fast Forward (Down, Left). Endings that start with Left: Fisheye (Left, Up), Faded Glory (Left, Right), Pixel Art (Left, Down), Hellscape (Left, Left). Learn them four at a time.

The $250,000 code is two circles: clockwise (Up, Right, Down, Left) and then counter-clockwise (Up, Left, Down, Right). Unlimited Focus is a seesaw: Down, Up, Up, then Down, Up three times, ending with Right. Cycle Weather repeats Down, Right, Up twice and finishes with Right. Move Time Forward is the same code with Up as the final press. The two wanted codes begin Left, Down, Right, Down, Up and split on the sixth press: Down for heat, Right for wanted.
Drunk is a stumble built from one pair. Left, Right comes three times, with one Up before it, then two Ups, then one: Up, Left, Right, then Up, Up, Left, Right, then Up, Left, Right.

A few more work the same way. Pause Time of Day is the Cycle Weather code with Left as the final press. Repair Vehicle and Unlimited Nitrous both begin Right, Down, Down, Right, Down, Right, Right, then end Down and Left. Parachute, All Explosive Weapons and the Hauners H-AT all begin Right, Up, Left, Up, Right, Up, Left, Up, then end Right, Left and Up. No Fall Damage is the simplest of all: Down, seven Ups, then Down.

Tap the sequences on your controller while it is off or on the home screen. Ten slow repetitions of an opener is usually enough for your thumb to learn it. The [cheats database](/cheats/) has a copy button for each code if you want the list on your phone beside you.

guides.description: How GTA 6 cheats differ from GTA 5: unlock challenges instead of free codes, D-pad-only inputs through the phone, and what stayed the same.
guides.h1: GTA 6 vs GTA 5 Cheats: What Changed and What Stayed the Same
guides.intro: If you played GTA 5, you remember typing in a button combo and getting a helicopter on the spot. GTA 6 keeps cheats but changes how you earn and enter them. Here is what returning players need to know.

p: In GTA 5, cheats worked from the first minute. You only needed to know the code. In GTA 6, every cheat is locked until the main story is complete, and all but four also have their own challenge. Body Armor asks for 100 workouts, and the ammo cheats ask for shooting-range medals. Knowing a code is no longer enough. You have to unlock the right to use it.

GTA 5 console codes mixed face buttons, triggers, bumpers and the D-pad, so PlayStation and Xbox lists looked different. GTA 6 codes use only the four D-pad directions, which makes every sequence identical on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Only the buttons you hold change: L1 and R1 on PS5, LB and RB on Xbox.

GTA 5 also let you dial cheats as phone numbers on the in-game phone. GTA 6 keeps the phone as the gateway in a different form. You take the phone out with Up on the D-pad, hold the shoulder buttons, and enter the arrows.

GTA 6 has 61 cheats across five groups. Alongside the familiar types, such as money, ammo, vehicle spawns, weather and wanted level, there is a large new group of 16 screen filters, plus physics cheats like Attack Force and Vehicle Force.

Cheats are still a single-player feature, and they still switch off trophies and achievements while active. In GTA 6 they also disable saving for the session, so the old habit of keeping a separate save is more important than ever. See [cheats, trophies and saving](/guides/gta-6-cheats-trophies-saving/).

guides.h1: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: The Best Method in Every Chapter
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** robberies and car sales. In Chapter 1, do Kenton's treasure dives and do not grind. In Chapter 2, sell untracked cars to Moses for a reported $1,000 or more each. Chapter 3 adds jewelry stores and Randy's Wish List, and bank vaults near the end of Chapter 4 pay the most. Figures below are payouts reported by players in launch week.

p: Robberies are the fastest money in GTA 6 for most of the game. Early on, that means small stores and criminal stashes. In Chapter 2 you can sell stolen cars. Chapter 3 adds jewelry stores and high-end car deliveries, and the biggest single payouts come from bank vaults near the end of Chapter 4.

sections.h2: Chapter 1: earn a little, protect it
p: Do not grind in Chapter 1. Launch guides report that cash from Chapter 1 does not follow you into Chapter 2, so large savings here are wasted. Earn what you need for a couple of guns and move on.

The safest early income is **Kenton's treasure dives**, which open after the mission Island Dreams. Kenton pays cash on the spot, and nobody shoots at you underwater. A first wreck is reported to pay about $1,400. Store registers add small amounts, and loot such as drugs, jewelry and marked bills can be dropped at Brian's lockup, which opens with the mission Lab Fees.

The mission Moses opens his garage in Port Gellhorn. He pays $1,000 or more for a stolen car, as long as it has no tracker. This is the first reliable, repeatable income in the game. Scan a car with the WAiNK app before you take it to see whether it is tracked and what it sells for. Full details are in the [car selling guide](/guides/gta-6-sell-cars/).

Three things unlock in Chapter 3. Pay 'n' Spray shops start buying cars that have a Standard Tracker, for around $4,000 each. Jewelry stores open up as robbery targets and are reported to pay $10,000 to $25,000 per store. See the [jewelry store guide](/guides/gta-6-jewelry-store-robbery/). Midway through the chapter, [Randy's Wish List](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/) pays $30,000 or more for each high-end car delivered in perfect condition.

Near the end of Chapter 4, an optional mission opens up bank vault robberies. A vault is reported to pay up to $205,000, the largest repeatable payout in the game. It also brings a heavy police response, so plan the getaway first. The [bank vault guide](/guides/gta-6-bank-vault-robbery/) covers the method.

Cash you are carrying is lost when you die or get arrested. Bank it as soon as you can. Until the Buck Me mission opens your bank account, use the stash under the floorboards in Jason's bedroom. The [money safety guide](/guides/gta-6-keep-money-safe/) explains both.

Once the credits roll, the [$250,000 cheat](/guides/gta-6-money-cheat/) becomes available. It disables saving and trophies for the session, so it is for testing purchases, not for building a real balance.

guides.intro: **Quick answer:** sell cars with no tracker to Moses in Port Gellhorn from Chapter 2, cars with a Standard Tracker at any Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3, and high-end cars to Randy midway through Chapter 3. Reported prices are $1,000+, around $4,000 and $30,000+ respectively. Scan every car with the WAiNK app first.

p: Before you steal a car to sell, scan it with the **WAiNK** app. Hold Up on the D-pad to open it. The scan shows whether the car has a tracker, its sell value and its Cost to Register. Which buyer will take the car depends on that tracker reading, so a five-second scan saves a wasted drive.

Moses runs a garage in Port Gellhorn and becomes available after the Chapter 2 story mission named after him. He pays $1,000 or more per car and is the best early source of steady money. See the [best cars to sell to Moses](/guides/gta-6-best-cars-to-sell-to-moses/) for the payouts guides report.

Moses only accepts cars **without** a tracker. Guides also report two limits: he will not take a car stolen right outside his own garage, and sales are rate-limited, with a short cooldown between cars and a cap on how many he buys per day. Sleeping resets the daily cap.

From early Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray buys cars that carry a **Standard Tracker**, which are exactly the cars Moses refuses. Two guides report that these shops also take cars with no tracker. A good car sells for around $4,000. Because Pay 'n' Spray shops are spread across the map, this is also more convenient than driving back to Port Gellhorn.

Randy wants specific high-end sports cars and pays $30,000 or more for each one delivered in perfect condition. You need the Key Cloner to steal them, which you receive in the mission that introduces Randy. This is the best car money in the game. See [Randy's Wish List](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/) for how it works and the [car list](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list-cars/) for where to find each one.

The same shops that buy cars can also register them so you keep them permanently. If a car is rare or fast, compare its sell value with its Cost to Register in WAiNK before deciding. guides.intro: **Quick answer:** the best-supported big payouts from Moses are for the vehicles he asks you to steal. Two guides name the Nightblade as his top payout, reported at roughly $6,300 to $7,150. The Bandito is the next one that two guides agree on, at around $3,400. For ordinary street cars, reported prices run from $150 to just over $5,000. Every figure on this page is a reported one, and each changes with the condition of the car.

p: Moses works out of Watkins Auto Parts in Port Gellhorn and starts buying cars in Chapter 2, after the story mission named after him. The [car selling guide](/guides/gta-6-sell-cars/) covers him alongside the other buyers.

His price depends on the model and on the state of that particular car. Guides agree that damage lowers the payout and that a car in perfect condition earns its full value. The same model is not always worth the same amount: two guides report a Willard Grouse at $150 one time and $275 another.
You do not have to guess. Scan a car with the **WAiNK** app before you steal it and the card shows its sell value, its Cost to Register and whether it has a tracker.

sections.h2: The best payouts: cars Moses asks for
p: Moses sometimes asks for a particular car and tells you where to look. Three guides describe these requests, and the cars involved are reported to pay more than almost anything you find on your own. The table lists the request cars that at least two guides name.

One guide reports an extra $500 on most of these jobs for bringing the car in good condition. Single guides also list a Vamos at about $4,200, a Karin Futo at $1,650 and an Annis Hellion at $1,540 as request cars. No second guide confirms those three yet.

sections.h2: Street cars: what is worth the drive
p: Outside those requests, reported values swing widely, and fewer guides have checked each car. Treat this table as a rough guide and trust the WAiNK scan in front of you over any list.

The pattern in the reports is simple. Working vehicles such as the Caracara 4x4 and the Speedo van are reported well above $2,000, while a tired Willard Grouse is reported at a few hundred dollars at best. One guide's advice on the Grouse is to skip it. If a scan shows only a few hundred dollars, the trip to Port Gellhorn is rarely worth your time.

p: Three guides agree on two firm rules. Moses refuses any car with a tracker, and he refuses cars stolen close to his own garage. One guide adds that he turns away vehicles towing a trailer.

The tracker rule is why the most valuable cars cannot go to him. Guides report that the expensive sports cars carry trackers, so Moses will not take them. From Chapter 3 you can take cars with a Standard Tracker to a Pay 'n' Spray, and later the high-end cars on [Randy's Wish List](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/) are reported to pay far more than anything Moses buys.

sections.h2: Limits: the wait and the daily budget
p: You cannot sell to Moses without a break, but guides do not agree on how the limit works. One reports a wait of about two minutes of real time after each sale, and notes that another guide says a few in-game hours. A different guide says only that Moses will not take a second car while he is still dealing with the last one. One guide reports that sleeping at a safehouse skips the wait.

One guide also reports a daily budget. Once Moses has spent it he stops buying until the next day, and a single car worth around $5,000 was enough to reach it early on. The same guide says the budget grows over time. No guide gives an exact figure, so none is given here.

Moses also registers cars, which makes them yours for good. Three guides agree that your first registration is free. After that you pay the Cost to Register shown on the WAiNK card, and reported costs are several times the sell value. One guide gives the example of a car that sells for $750 and costs $4,750 to register.

So sell the ordinary cars and keep only the ones you will really drive. The guide to [keeping and registering cars](/guides/gta-6-keep-cars-register/) explains the steps, and [making money by chapter](/guides/gta-6-make-money-fast/) shows where Moses fits into your Chapter 2 income.

faqs.q: What is the best car to sell to Moses in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Two guides name the Nightblade, which Moses asks for himself. It is reported to pay roughly $6,300 to $7,150. The Bandito is the next one two guides agree on, at around $3,400.

faqs.q: How much does Moses pay for cars?
faqs.a: Reported prices run from $150 for a worn Willard Grouse to just over $5,000 for a Caracara 4x4. The cars he asks for by name can pay more. Condition changes every price.

faqs.q: Why has Moses stopped buying my cars?
faqs.a: He needs time between sales, and one guide reports a daily budget that stops him buying once it is spent. He also refuses cars with a tracker and cars stolen near his garage.

faqs.q: Does damage lower the price Moses pays?
faqs.a: Yes. Guides agree that damage lowers the payout and that a car in perfect condition earns its full value, so drive carefully on the way.

guides.title: GTA 6 Bank Vault Robbery: How to Unlock and Rob Vaults
guides.description: How bank vault robberies work in GTA 6: when they unlock, how to get inside, the reported $205,000 payout and the Maximum Withdrawal trophy.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Bank Vault Robberies: Unlock, Method and Payout
guides.intro: Bank vaults are the biggest repeatable score in GTA 6. They arrive late, they bring the police down hard, and they are tied to a Silver trophy. Details below come from launch-week guides, so treat exact figures as reported, not official.

p: Vault robberies open near the end of Chapter 4 through an optional mission. Because it is optional, it is possible to finish the chapter without it, so look for it before you move on if you want the trophy.
The reported method relies on the armored vans that service banks.
steps: Follow an armored van to a bank, or wait at a bank until one arrives.
When the guard carries money inside, the vault is open. Follow the guard in while it is.
Take the cash and leave. Expect an immediate, heavy wanted level.
Escape on something fast, then switch vehicles to shake the description.
Deliver the take to your fence to turn it into usable money.
sections.after: Guides report that the fence, Yasmani, also sells tips on van routes. Jobs done for him earlier in Chapter 3 are reported to be a requirement for that service.

p: A single vault is reported to pay up to **$205,000**. For comparison, a jewelry store pays $10,000 to $25,000 and a Wish List supercar $30,000 or more. One vault is worth roughly eight to twenty jewelry stores.

The getaway is the hard part. Park your escape vehicle before you start, facing the exit. A motorbike gets through traffic better than a car. Once you break line of sight, deal with what the police know about you: change vehicle, change clothes and holster your weapon. The [wanted level guide](/guides/gta-6-wanted-level-heat/) explains each heat icon.

Robbing five bank vaults and escaping each time earns **Maximum Withdrawal**, a Silver trophy worth 40 Gamerscore on Xbox. It is one of six Silver trophies in the [GTA 6 trophy list](/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/).

faqs.q: When can you rob bank vaults in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Near the end of Chapter 4, after an optional mission opens them up.

faqs.q: How much does a bank vault pay in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Launch guides report up to $205,000 per vault.

faqs.q: What is the Maximum Withdrawal trophy?
faqs.a: A Silver trophy for robbing five bank vaults and escaping.

guides.title: GTA 6 Stash vs BuckMe: How to Keep Your Money Safe
guides.description: Carried cash is lost when you die or get busted in GTA 6. How the floorboard stash and BuckMe work, and what to move before Chapter 2 starts.
guides.h1: How to Keep Your Money Safe in GTA 6: The Stash and BuckMe
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** yes, you lose the cash you are carrying when you die or get busted. Money in Jason's floorboard stash or your BuckMe bank account is safe from that. Use the stash until the Chapter 1 mission Buck Me, then deposit at any ATM. Before Tourist Trap, move what you want to keep into Family Savings, because guides report that the stash and the checking balance do not carry into Chapter 2.

p: Money you are carrying disappears if you are Wasted or Busted. Money that has been stashed or banked is safe. That makes the rule simple: after any job, put the cash away before you do anything risky.

sections.h2: Before you have a bank: the floorboard stash
p: In the opening hours you have no bank account. Go into Jason's bedroom and interact with the loose floorboards beside the bed. You can deposit cash there and take it out later. It is basic, but it is the only protection you have until the bank opens.
Players also report that some mission pay and money from contacts is delivered to the mailbox outside Jason's house, so check it when you come home.

The Chapter 1 mission **Buck Me** takes Jason and Lucia to the bank and opens a BuckMe account. From then on, deposit cash at an ATM and it is safe. Banked money can also be used to pay in shops, so there is little reason to carry more than pocket change.

Guides report that three things are wiped when Chapter 1 ends: the cash you are carrying, the balance in your BuckMe checking account and anything left under the floorboards. Money in **Family Savings**, the savings side of the BuckMe app, carries over. Two guides suggest putting $5,000 into Family Savings before you start **Tourist Trap**, the point of no return for Chapter 1, and spending the rest on guns and clothes, which you keep. Guides describe Family Savings as a savings goal, not spending money, so do not put in more than you mean to. The [Chapter 1 checklist](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-checklist/) has the full routine.

steps: Finish a robbery or sale.
Lose any wanted level first. Dying on the way to the bank costs you the lot.
Deposit at the nearest ATM, or at the stash early on.
Make a manual save. See [how to save](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/).

faqs.q: Do you lose money when you die in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Yes. Cash you are carrying is lost when you die or get arrested. Stashed and banked money is safe.

faqs.q: How do I get a bank account in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Complete the Chapter 1 mission Buck Me. It opens your BuckMe account, and you can then deposit at ATMs.

faqs.q: Where is the money stash in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Under the loose floorboards beside the bed in Jason's bedroom.

guides.keyword: how to rob stores in gta 6
guides.title: How to Rob Stores in GTA 6: Disable the Alarm and Open the Safe
guides.description: Rob a store in GTA 6 without the police showing up: threaten the staff, switch off the alarm in the back room, open the safe and destroy the footage.
guides.h1: How to Rob Stores in GTA 6 Without Getting Caught
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** aim at the staff and threaten them so they empty the register. Then go to the back room and switch off the alarm, because the alarm is what calls the police. Open the back-room safe, destroy the camera footage and bank the cash. Each step is explained below.

sections.h2: Pick a target on the map
p: Open the map and look under **Robberies**. Stores are listed there with two numbers that matter: a **Security** level of Low, Medium or High, and a **Take Value**. Start with Low security stores. High security places are reported to have armed guards. You can also rob stores that are not flagged on the map. If you can walk into it, you can hold it up.

steps: **Control the room.** Draw your weapon and aim at the staff, then use Threaten so they empty the register. Make sure they stay put. Staff who are left alone can run, fight back or raise the alarm.
**Disable the alarm.** The security system is switched off from the back room. The alarm is what calls the police, so this is the step that buys you time.
**Open the safe.** The back room usually has a safe that holds far more than the register. The code comes from inside the store, either a note in the back room or the staff.
**Destroy the footage.** Cameras do not call the police, but they record your face. Find the security computer and destroy the recordings so you cannot be identified later.
**Leave by the back** if there is an exit, and get clear of the area.

p: Kicking in a back door sets off the alarm. Later in the game the **Snap Gun**, a lock-picking tool sold by a fence in Vice City, opens doors silently. With it you can reach the back room before anyone knows you are there. It is essential for [jewelry stores](/guides/gta-6-jewelry-store-robbery/).

Police share your description over the radio. Change clothes, swap or respray your vehicle and holster your weapon to clear what they know. The [wanted level guide](/guides/gta-6-wanted-level-heat/) covers each icon. Then bank the cash, because you lose whatever you are carrying if you are caught. See [keeping money safe](/guides/gta-6-keep-money-safe/).

sections.h2: Trophies and cheats tied to stores
list: **Retail Therapy** (Bronze): rob three shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level.
**Faded Glory cheat**: rob 50 stores with your partner. Log your count in the [Tracker](/tracker/).
How violently you rob also moves your [Criminal Profile](/guides/gta-6-criminal-profile/). Knocking staff out instead of shooting keeps it clean.

faqs.q: How do you rob a store in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Aim your weapon at the staff and use Threaten to empty the register. For a clean job, also disable the alarm in the back room, open the safe and destroy the security footage.

faqs.q: How do I stop the police being called?
faqs.a: Disable the security system from the back room and keep the staff under control. The alarm is what alerts the police.

faqs.q: Can you rob any store in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Yes. Any business you can walk into can be held up, not only the ones listed on the map.

guides.title: How to Rob a Jewelry Store in GTA 6: Snap Gun, Safe and Payout
guides.description: Jewelry stores unlock in GTA 6 Chapter 3. Get the Snap Gun, switch off the alarm, clear the cases and crack the safe for a reported $10,000 to $25,000.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Jewelry Store Robberies: How They Work and What They Pay
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** jewelry stores unlock in Chapter 3. Buy the Snap Gun from a fence in Vice City so you can get in without the alarm, switch off security in the back room, smash the cases and crack the safe. Each store is reported to pay $10,000 to $25,000.

p: Jewelry store jobs open in Chapter 3, once the story reaches Vice City and introduces the fence who buys the goods. From that point jewelry stores appear as robbery targets, each with a security level and a take value on the map.

The Snap Gun is a lock-picking tool sold by a fence in Vice City. It opens doors without setting off the alarm, which is what makes a quiet jewelry job possible. Without it you are forcing your way in, and forced entry triggers the alarm.

steps: Check the store's security level and take value on the map before you commit.
Enter quietly with the Snap Gun, or control the staff by threatening them so nobody raises the alarm.
Go to the back room and switch off the security system.
Smash the display cases and take the jewelry.
Crack the back-room safe. Clearing the cases alone is reported not to count as a full robbery.
Destroy the camera footage, leave, and take the goods to your fence.

p: A jewelry store is reported to pay **$10,000 to $25,000**. Players also report that stores marked with a diamond icon are worth more than those marked with a ring. Hitting several stores in one run before the police catch up is the fastest way to stack money in Chapter 3.

Robbing a jewelry store without being detected earns **Sneakthief**, a Bronze trophy. The Snap Gun is what makes this realistic. It is listed with the other 54 in the [trophy guide](/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/).

Jewelry stores carry you through Chapter 3 alongside [Randy's Wish List](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/). Late in Chapter 4, [bank vaults](/guides/gta-6-bank-vault-robbery/) take over as the top earner.

faqs.q: When can you rob jewelry stores in GTA 6?
faqs.a: From Chapter 3, after the story introduces the Vice City fence who buys jewelry.

faqs.q: How much do jewelry stores pay in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Launch guides report $10,000 to $25,000 per store.

faqs.q: What is the Snap Gun in GTA 6?
faqs.a: A lock-picking tool bought from a fence in Vice City. It opens doors without triggering the alarm.

guides.title: Fastest Cars in GTA 6: Top 7 Ranked by Speed Stat
guides.description: The fastest car in GTA 6 is the Truffade Thrax with a stock speed of 8.7. The top seven ranked by in-game stats, and how to get the top two.
guides.h1: The Fastest Cars in GTA 6, Ranked by In-Game Speed
guides.intro: The fastest car in GTA 6 is the Truffade Thrax. It has a stock speed rating of 8.7 out of 10, ahead of every other car players have measured since launch. This ranking uses the speed stat the game itself shows for each vehicle, because that is the one number several sources agree on.

p: Supercars take five of the seven places. The two exceptions are worth noting: the Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire is a muscle car that ties for fourth, and the Pfister Comet S2 leads the sports class.

You will see lists online that rank GTA 6 cars by top speed in mph and put a different car first. Most of those were published before launch and are estimates. The in-game stat is what you can check for yourself in the vehicle menu, so that is what this page uses. If measured top speeds are confirmed later, they will be added.

sections.h2: How to get the Thrax and Emerus
p: The two fastest cars are both rewards in the cheat system. Completing every Shopping challenge unlocks the **Truffade Thrax** spawn cheat, and completing every Vehicle challenge unlocks the **Progen Emerus** spawn cheat. Both are covered in the [challenges guide](/guides/gta-6-challenges-explained/). Guides also report that the Thrax is the reward for finishing [Randy's Wish List](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/), and that the Emerus appears as a rare spawn in wealthy parts of Vice City.

High-end cars cannot simply be driven away. You need the **Key Cloner**, which arrives midway through Chapter 3. Players report that mansion driveways and garages in the wealthy districts are the best places to look. Scan a car with WAiNK first to check for a tracker.

Raw speed is not everything. The Pfister Comet S2 pairs its 7.7 speed with 8.0 acceleration and 7.6 handling, which makes it easier to drive quickly through traffic than a faster supercar. It is reported to be offered to Jason during a Chapter 4 story mission, so you do not need to steal one.

A stolen car is lost unless you register it. Once you find something quick, follow the [guide to keeping cars](/guides/gta-6-keep-cars-register/) and give it a slot in one of your [garages](/guides/gta-6-garages/).

faqs.a: The Truffade Thrax, with a stock speed rating of 8.7 out of 10.

faqs.q: How do I get the Truffade Thrax?
faqs.a: Complete every Shopping challenge to unlock its spawn cheat. It is also reported as the reward for completing Randy's Wish List.

faqs.q: What is the fastest non-supercar in GTA 6?
faqs.a: The Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, a muscle car with a 7.8 speed rating, followed by the Pfister Comet S2 sports car at 7.7.

guides.keyword: how to keep cars in gta 6
guides.title: How to Keep Cars in GTA 6: Swap Plates and Register Them
guides.description: Stolen cars vanish in GTA 6 unless you register them. Swap the plates at Moses from Chapter 2 or Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3, then call them with Scooter Bros.
guides.h1: How to Keep Stolen Cars in GTA 6: Registration, Scooter Bros and the Impound
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** you keep a stolen car by registering it, which swaps its plates and makes it your personal vehicle. Moses registers cars with no tracker from Chapter 2, and any Pay 'n' Spray registers cars from Chapter 3. You cannot keep stolen cars in Chapter 1.

sections.h2: What you can keep, by chapter
list: **Chapter 1:** you cannot keep stolen cars. You have Jason's own car, and you can call Joey from your contacts to bring it back.
**Chapter 2:** the story mission Moses unlocks registration at his garage in Port Gellhorn. He registers cars that have no tracker.
**Chapter 3:** any Pay 'n' Spray can register cars, including those with a Standard Tracker.

steps: Scan the car with the **WAiNK** app before stealing it. The scan shows its tracker status, sell value and **Cost to Register**.
Steal it and lose any wanted level.
Drive to Moses or a Pay 'n' Spray.
Choose **Register**. The plates are swapped and the car becomes yours.
Park it in a garage or parking space you own.
sections.after: The Cost to Register is several times the sell value on many cars, so decide whether the car is really worth keeping before you pay.

p: Finishing the Moses mission also installs the **Scooter Bros** app on your phone. It lists your registered vehicles and delivers one to you for a fee. It is also how you recover a personal vehicle that has been lost or destroyed.
When the police impound a personal vehicle you have two options. Pay Scooter Bros to fetch it, or go to the impound lot and drive it out yourself.
Each registered car needs somewhere to live. Garages bought through the Vice City Real Estate app each add a space. See [all eight garages and prices](/guides/gta-6-garages/).
Registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app earns **On the Spot**, a Bronze trophy. If you plan to buy every garage anyway, this comes naturally as you fill them.

faqs.q: How do you save a car in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Register it at Moses' garage (Chapter 2) or a Pay 'n' Spray (Chapter 3). Unregistered stolen cars are lost when you leave them, die or get arrested.

faqs.q: How do I call my car in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Use the Scooter Bros app on your phone, which unlocks with the Moses mission in Chapter 2. In Chapter 1, call Joey for Jason's car.

faqs.q: How do I get my car back from the impound?
faqs.a: Pay Scooter Bros to recover it, or drive it out of the impound lot yourself.

guides.title: GTA 6 Garages: All 8 Locations and Prices
guides.description: All 8 garages you can buy in GTA 6 with prices from $4,000 to $40,000, how to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app, and the Little Boxes trophy.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Garages: All 8 You Can Buy, Prices and How to Unlock Them
guides.intro: Garages are the only property you can buy in GTA 6 at launch. There are eight for sale, each holding one car, and owning all of them earns a trophy. You cannot buy homes or businesses.

p: Garages are sold through the **Vice City Real Estate** app on your phone. The app arrives shortly after the Chapter 2 mission **Daily Driver**. Open it, pick a garage and pay from your bank balance.

The eight garages are widely reported at the prices below, for a total of **$160,000**. One source reports these figures already include a 20% discount that applies once your BuckMe savings pass $100,000, which would put the undiscounted total at $200,000. If the app shows you higher prices, that is the likely reason.

Mitchell Auto Center is the cheapest at $4,000 and sits near Port Gellhorn, where Chapter 2 takes place, so it is the natural first purchase. After that, 7th Avenue is the cheapest garage inside Vice City and is useful from Chapter 3 onward.

You also receive garages without paying. The story hands over several in Vice City during the later chapters. Others come with editions and memberships: the Ultimate Edition, the Vintage Vice City pre-order pack and GTA+ each include one. None of these count toward the trophy.

Buying all eight garages from the app earns **Little Boxes**, a Bronze trophy. Money spent here also counts toward **Treat Yo Self**, which asks you to spend $100,000 across all shops. Both are in the [trophy list](/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/).

A garage is only useful with a registered car in it. The [guide to keeping cars](/guides/gta-6-keep-cars-register/) explains registration, and the [fastest cars list](/guides/gta-6-fastest-cars/) helps you decide what deserves a slot.

data.caption: Garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate app

faqs.q: How many garages can you buy in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Eight, through the Vice City Real Estate app. Each holds one car.

faqs.q: How much do all the garages cost in GTA 6?
faqs.a: About $160,000 in total at the widely reported prices, from $4,000 to $40,000 each.

faqs.q: Can you buy houses or businesses in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Not at launch. Garages are the only property for sale.

guides.title: GTA 6 Randy's Wish List: Unlock, Key Cloner and $30K+ Per Car
guides.description: Randy's Wish List opens midway through Chapter 3 of GTA 6. Get the Key Cloner, deliver high-end cars undamaged and earn a reported $30,000+ each.
guides.h1: Randy's Wish List in GTA 6: How to Unlock It and Get Paid
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** Randy's Wish List unlocks about halfway through Chapter 3, when a mission for Randy gives you the Key Cloner. Steal the high-end cars on his list and deliver them undamaged to his garage in western Vice City for a reported $30,000 or more each. It is the best-paying car job in the game.

p: The Wish List opens about halfway through Chapter 3. A mission for Randy has you steal a supercar for him, and it gives you the **Key Cloner**. After that mission, the list is available and Randy's garage in western Vice City accepts deliveries.

High-end cars cannot be taken like ordinary ones. The Key Cloner is the tool that gets you into them. You keep it after the mission, so it is useful well beyond Randy's list. Any supercar you want for yourself needs it too.

steps: Check the list for a car Randy still needs. Guides list between 15 and 20 cars. See [every car and where to find it](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list-cars/).
Find one. Most drive around Vice City, and some parked examples are marked on your map.
Steal it with the Key Cloner.
Drive carefully. Randy pays full price only for a car in perfect condition.
Deliver it to his garage.
sections.after: Each car is reported to pay **$30,000 or more**. Damage cuts the price, so a slow, clean drive beats a fast one.

list: **Supply & Demand** (Bronze trophy): awarded for finishing Randy's strand. Guides report it arrives after 16 deliveries.
Randy's deliveries are also reported to be part of the 100% checklist.
Finishing the full list is reported to reward the Truffade Thrax, the [fastest car in the game](/guides/gta-6-fastest-cars/).

p: Lose the police before you head to the garage. Arriving with a wanted level risks the car and the payout. Avoid motorways at speed, since one heavy crash can ruin a delivery. And scan before you steal: the WAiNK app shows whether a car has a tracker.

faqs.q: How do you unlock Randy's Wish List in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Complete Randy's mission midway through Chapter 3. It gives you the Key Cloner and opens the list.

faqs.q: How much does Randy pay per car?
faqs.a: Launch guides report $30,000 or more for each car delivered in perfect condition.

faqs.q: What is the Key Cloner?
faqs.a: A tool that lets you steal high-end cars. You receive it during Randy's mission in Chapter 3.

guides.title: GTA 6 Randy's Cars: Every Wish List Car and Where to Find It
guides.description: The cars Randy wants in GTA 6 and where guides agree you can find each one, from Capri driveways to Starfish Island garages. Lists differ on the total.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Randy's Wish List Cars: Every Car and Where to Find It
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** guides do not agree on how many cars are on Randy's Wish List. Fifteen cars appear on every detailed list, and up to five more appear on some. Most of them turn up at the big houses in Capri. A cluster sits in mansion garages on Starfish Island, three are at the car dealerships in Southside, and a few have one-off spots such as a junkyard in Hamlet. Spawns are not fixed, so the table below only lists places that at least two guides agree on, and says so where they do not.

sections.h2: The cars and where guides agree
p: Sources differ on the total. Two car lists name all 20 vehicles below. Two other detailed guides are shorter: one lists 16 cars, and one says the list starts with 15. The Coquette D10, the Cypher, the Carbonizzare and the Neon are on the two longer lists only. One guide says the Coquette D10 comes from a separate job for Randy, and that the Zorrusso is the car from the story job that opens the list, not an entry on it. The other 15 cars are on every list. Check the list in your own game before you hunt for those five.

Locations are harder. Guides often put the same car in different places, because most of these cars can appear in more than one spot. A place is listed here only when at least two guides name it. Where they do not agree, the table says so.

p: **Capri** is the place to start. More than half the list is reported at the large houses there, parked on driveways, behind gates or inside garages. A slow lap of the neighbourhood, scanning as you go, can cover the Paragon, the '96 Infernus, the Toros, the Neon, the Growler and the Carbonizzare.

**Starfish Island** is the second stop. Two guides put the Vitello, the Windsor Drop and the Baller ST-D in mansion garages there, and one says all three share a single property. The Furia is reported at another mansion on the island. One guide mentions a guard and locked garage doors.
**Southside** has the dealerships. The Banshee is reported at the Sunrise dealership, the Cypher at the Übermacht dealership and the Growler at a used car dealership in the same district.

That leaves the one-off spots: the Gauntlet Hellfire at a junkyard in Hamlet, the Jugular outside the Bite shop north of Ocean Beach, the Coquette D10 on Waxman Island and the Itali RSX in a house garage on the Vespucci Islands.

sections.h2: If a car is not where a guide says
p: This will happen. Only a handful of these cars are described as fixed spawns, and guides disagree even on those. Treat every location as a place to check, not a promise.
list: Scan parked cars with the WAiNK app before you commit. It identifies the car and shows whether it has a tracker.
Come back at a different time of day. Two guides tie some cars to a time of day, or say they are not there on every visit.
Ask Randy. Guides report that he gives leads on cars he still needs, and that calling him can produce a job for one of them.
One guide reports that saving and reloading refreshes which cars are parked in an area. That comes from a single source, so treat it as a tip to try.

p: Many of these cars cannot be opened without the Key Cloner, which you get from Randy's own job in Chapter 3. The [Randy's Wish List guide](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/) covers how the list unlocks and what the tool does.

Deliveries go to Randy at Leonida Auto World, his garage in western Vice City. He pays more for a car with no damage. One guide puts the bonus for a perfect car at double, and launch guides report $30,000 or more per car. Drive gently and lose any wanted level first. One guide suggests a stop at a repair shop if you have scraped the car.

If you would rather keep one of these cars, the [guide to keeping cars](/guides/gta-6-keep-cars-register/) explains registration, and the [garages guide](/guides/gta-6-garages/) lists where to store it. For ordinary cars, the [car selling guide](/guides/gta-6-sell-cars/) compares the other buyers.

sections.h2: What finishing the list gives you
p: Two guides agree that delivering every car unlocks a way to handle cars with advanced trackers. One says it lets you sell them. The other names the reward as the Advanced Tracker Demobiliser, a tool for removing trackers.
Two guides also describe an extra classic, a Mamba GT at Leaf Links. Randy is reported to reveal it only after you have handed in a good share of the list. One guide puts that at about ten cars.

Randy's strand also has its own trophy, Supply & Demand, and is reported to count toward 100%. The [trophy list](/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/) has the details, and the [100% checklist](/guides/gta-6-100-percent-completion/) shows what else counts.

faqs.q: How many cars are on Randy's Wish List in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Sources differ. Fifteen cars appear on every detailed list, one guide lists 16 and two list 20. Check Randy's list in your own game.

faqs.q: Where are most of Randy's cars in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Capri. More than half the list is reported at the large houses there. Starfish Island and the Southside dealerships cover most of the rest.
