guides.title: Best Weapons in GTA 6: Top Guns by Class and Price
guides.description: The best guns in GTA 6 by class, with prices and stats: Duke 556, Girardi ES9, Fairview FF-50 and more, plus what to buy first.
guides.h1: The Best Weapons in GTA 6 for Every Class
guides.intro: GTA 6 has 66 standard weapons, plus named and modded variants you can find in the world. Two guides break the 66 down as 53 guns, nine melee weapons and four explosives. You do not need most of them. A handful cover every situation, and the best first purchases are cheap. Stats below are the in-game ratings out of 10.

p: Two guns are discounted during the Chapter 1 mission **Gear Up**, and both are worth taking. The **Moreland 850** shotgun drops from $700 to $350, and the **Hawk & Little Mediator** tactical rifle drops from $900 to $450. Pick whichever suits you and come back for the other later.

If you buy one rifle, make it the **Duke 556**. It costs $1,450, holds 30 rounds and accepts a wide range of attachments. Nearly every launch guide names it the best general-purpose weapon, and it stays useful for the whole story.

The **Girardi ES9** is the most recommended everyday pistol because it is accurate and easy to handle. For raw damage, the **Fairview Kalinga .50** pistol and the **Scorpio Akulus** revolver both rate 7.0. The Akulus costs $3,000.

Two shotguns top the damage chart at 8.0: the **Shrewsbury Drifter** at $1,150 and the **Mason & Keen Shortstraw** at $1,625. Both hold only two shells, and the Drifter has no modification slots. The Moreland 850 does less damage per shot but is more forgiving. For a fast-firing option, the **Vom Feuer VF5** submachine gun costs $2,325.

The **Fairview FF-50** is the hardest-hitting sniper rifle at 8.5 damage. It costs $3,975 and holds five rounds. The **Fortune & Son Laird 350** is the most accurate gun in the game at 8.8 accuracy, which makes it the easier rifle to land shots with.

The **ADB M350** is the top machine gun at 6.5 damage. The two launchers hit hardest of all: the **Hauners H-AT** rocket launcher at 9.6 damage for $16,000, and the **Deever Tech GLR40** grenade launcher at 9.2 for $15,500.

Two of these guns also appear in the cheat list. Blowing up 100 vehicles unlocks the Hauners H-AT cheat, and hitting 100 enemies with explosive damage unlocks an explosive Mason & Keen Shortstraw. See [combat cheats](/guides/gta-6-combat-cheats/). For where to buy everything and how to keep it, read the [gun shop guide](/guides/gta-6-gun-shops/).

faqs.q: What is the best gun in GTA 6?
faqs.a: The Duke 556 assault rifle is the best all-round weapon. It costs $1,450, holds 30 rounds and takes many attachments.

faqs.q: What weapon should I buy first in GTA 6?
faqs.a: The Moreland 850 shotgun or the Hawk & Little Mediator rifle. Both are half price during the Chapter 1 mission Gear Up.

faqs.q: What is the best sniper rifle in GTA 6?
faqs.a: The Fairview FF-50, with a damage rating of 8.5. It costs $3,975.

guides.keyword: gta 6 gun shop how to buy weapons
guides.title: GTA 6 Gun Shops: Best Stores, Unlocks and Keeping Your Guns
guides.description: Where to buy guns in GTA 6, which shops stock what, how more weapons unlock, and why only guns you buy come back after you die or get busted.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Gun Shops: How to Buy, Unlock and Keep Your Weapons
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** gun shops open in the Chapter 1 mission Gear Up. Chuck's Tackle & Shot, Big Shots and Iron & Oak carry different stock, and larger Ammu-Nation stores add sniper rifles and launchers. Only guns you buy are owned. Guns picked up from enemies are lost when you die, unless you keep them in your car's trunk.

p: Gun shops open with the Chapter 1 mission **Gear Up**, which sends Jason to buy a long gun. Buy one during the mission. Two guns are half price at that point, and skipping the purchase is reported to stall the next story call.

Guns are sold through Ammu-Nation distributors under local shop names. Three you will see early are **Chuck's Tackle & Shot** in the Keys, **Big Shots** in Hamlet and **Iron & Oak**. Stock differs between them. Chuck's and Big Shots carry the Duke 556 and the Shrewsbury Drifter, while Iron & Oak and Big Shots carry pistols, submachine guns and the Scorpio Akulus. Larger Ammu-Nation stores add sniper rifles and launchers.

Not everything is on the shelf at once. Part of the catalogue unlocks as you buy more weapons. Some guns are reported to appear after 8 further purchases and others after 13, including the best sniper rifle. Buying cheap guns you do not plan to use is one way to open the better ones sooner.

This is the rule that matters most. A gun you **buy** is owned. If you die or get arrested, it can be recovered. A gun you **pick up** from an enemy is not owned, and it is lost when you die or are busted.
To hold on to a found gun, store it in the trunk of your personal vehicle. The trunk also holds spare outfits, which helps when you need to change clothes to shake the police.

You are reported to be limited to two sidearms and two long guns at a time, so choose your loadout before a job. Tap L1 on PS5 or LB on Xbox to holster or draw, and hold it to open the loadout wheel. Keep weapons holstered in public. Witnesses who see a drawn gun call the police, and a visible weapon is one of the things officers use to identify you.

Most guns can be modified with attachments. A few cannot, including the Shrewsbury Drifter. Melee weapons are cheap. Brass knuckles are listed at $95 and knives at around $300. For recommendations on what to buy, see the [best weapons guide](/guides/gta-6-best-weapons/).

faqs.q: When can you buy guns in GTA 6?
faqs.a: From the Chapter 1 mission Gear Up, which unlocks gun shops.

faqs.q: Do you lose your guns when you die in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Guns you bought can be recovered. Guns you picked up from enemies are lost unless you stored them in your vehicle's trunk.

faqs.q: How do I unlock more guns in the shop?
faqs.a: Buy more weapons. Parts of the catalogue are reported to unlock after 8 and 13 further purchases.

faqs.q: Do you keep your guns after Chapter 1 in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Guides report that guns you bought carry over. In Chapter 2 you collect them from the weapons locker at an Ammu-Nation store.

guides.title: GTA 6 Wanted Level and Heat: How to Lose the Police
guides.description: GTA 6 has six wanted stars and a Heat system that tracks your outfit, car, weapon and partner. What each star colour means and how to lose the cops.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Wanted Level and Heat System: How to Lose the Police
guides.intro: Losing the police in GTA 6 is no longer just a matter of driving away. The wanted level now goes up to six stars, and a second layer called Heat records what officers actually know about you. Clear what they know and they cannot pick you out again.

p: **Stars** show how hard the police are responding, from one to six. **Heat** is the set of red icons under the stars. Each icon is a detail the police have on you, taken from witnesses, cameras or their own eyes. The more icons you carry, the easier you are to find again.

table.caption: Wanted star states
rows: A crime was reported, but police do not know it was you
Walk away calmly before they arrive
Police have identified you and can see you
Police have lost sight of you and are searching
Leave the search area without being seen
You escaped, but Heat remains around your last known position
Stay out of the marked area and clear your Heat icons

sections.h2: The Heat icons and how to clear each one
list: **Outfit:** change clothes. Keep a spare outfit in your vehicle's trunk.
**Appearance:** cover your face with a mask or a helmet.
**Vehicle:** switch cars, or respray at a Pay 'n' Spray.
**Weapon:** holster it or put it in the trunk so nobody can see it.
**Partner:** split up. Hold Right on the D-pad to open the partner menu and send them away.
p: Clearing an icon takes effect straight away, so a quick change of clothes and car after a chase is often all you need.

sections.h2: How to lose a wanted level, step by step
steps: Break line of sight. Alleys, car parks and tight corners work better than open roads.
Get out of the search area marked on the map while the stars are grey. They flash and then clear.
Deal with every red Heat icon: clothes, face, vehicle, weapon, partner.
Stay away from the area until the Heat fades. Being spotted there, or committing another crime, brings the wanted level straight back.

sections.h2: Avoiding a wanted level in the first place
p: Most wanted levels start with a witness. Keep your weapon holstered in public, deal with cameras during robberies, and wear a mask when you plan a job. A tracked car can also bring attention, so scan vehicles with WAiNK before stealing them.

list: **Hot Together** (Bronze): lose a four-star wanted level with your partner.
Losing a three-star wanted level 25 times unlocks the Raise Heat Level cheat, and 50 times unlocks Raise Wanted Level. See [wanted level cheats](/guides/gta-6-wanted-level-cheats/).
Surviving six minutes at six stars unlocks the Migraine filter cheat. Count your escapes in the [Tracker](/tracker/).

faqs.q: How many wanted stars are in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Six.

faqs.q: How do you lose the police in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Break line of sight, leave the search area, then clear your Heat icons by changing clothes, covering your face, switching vehicle, holstering your weapon and splitting from your partner.

faqs.q: What do red wanted stars mean in GTA 6?
faqs.a: You have escaped the chase, but police still have Heat on you around your last known location. If you are spotted there, the chase restarts.

guides.title: GTA 6 Criminal Record (Criminal Profile): All 5 Crime Levels
guides.description: GTA 6's criminal record is the Criminal Profile: five levels from Professional to Irredeemable. What raises it, what it changes and how to bring it down.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Criminal Profile: All 5 Levels and How to Change Yours
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** GTA 6's criminal record is called the Criminal Profile. It has five levels: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable. Killing civilians and police pushes it up, while stealth and non-lethal play bring it down. Irredeemable is permanent for that character, and the profile changes how the police treat you.

list: **Professional:** clean jobs, little or no bloodshed.
**Hardened**
**Violent**
**Psycho:** frequent killing of civilians and police.
**Irredeemable:** the end of the scale, reached by staying at Psycho behaviour for too long.
p: Jason and Lucia each have their own profile, so the two characters can end up with very different reputations.

table.caption: Actions that shift the Criminal Profile
rows: Disabling alarms, destroying footage and leaving cleanly

p: The main effect is on the police. At Psycho and Irredeemable, officers are more likely to open fire on sight, and at Psycho they are reported to stop accepting a surrender. Your profile also decides which actions build your maximum Focus, the slow-motion ability. A Professional gains Focus from stealthy and peaceful play, while a Psycho gains it from headshots. An Irredeemable character is reported to get no Focus bonus at all.

The first four levels move up and down as your behaviour changes. Irredeemable does not. Once a character reaches it, guides agree it cannot be undone for that character. Make a manual save in a separate slot before any rampage. See [how to save](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/).

sections.h2: How to get back to Professional
p: A single bad moment does not wreck a clean profile, and recovery is possible from Hardened, Violent and Psycho. Play quietly for a while: use takedowns instead of gunfire, threaten instead of shoot during [store robberies](/guides/gta-6-rob-stores/), switch off alarms, wipe the footage and leave without a chase.
A hidden Bronze trophy, **Actions Speak Louder**, is awarded for performing 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It counts changes in either direction, so normal play earns it over time.

faqs.q: What are the Criminal Profile levels in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.

faqs.q: Can you undo Irredeemable in GTA 6?
faqs.a: No. Irredeemable is reported to be permanent for that character, so save before risking it.

faqs.q: Do Jason and Lucia share a Criminal Profile?
faqs.a: No. Each character has a separate profile.

guides.title: GTA 6 Beginner Tips: 15 Things to Know Before You Start
guides.description: 15 GTA 6 beginner tips that save you money and progress: bank your cash, save by hand, buy your guns, read the Heat icons and use Focus.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Beginner Tips: 15 Things to Know in Your First Hours
guides.intro: GTA 6 explains very little about its new systems, and a few of them can cost you hours if you learn them the hard way. These 15 tips cover the mistakes new players make most often. There are no story spoilers.

list: **1. Save by hand.** Autosave only runs when a mission ends, and there is no mission replay. Use Pause, Game, Save Game. See [how to save](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/).
**2. Finish the Prologue in one sitting.** Manual saving is reported to be unavailable until it ends.
**3. Keep one save per chapter.** If you miss something, you will have a way back.
**4. Never carry your savings.** Cash in your pocket is lost when you die or get arrested.
**5. Use the floorboard stash.** Before you have a bank account, stash cash under the loose floorboards in Jason's bedroom.
**6. Bank it after Buck Me.** That Chapter 1 mission opens your BuckMe account. More in [keeping money safe](/guides/gta-6-keep-money-safe/).
**7. Buy your guns.** Bought guns can be recovered after you die. Guns taken from enemies cannot. Details in the [gun shop guide](/guides/gta-6-gun-shops/).
**8. Use your trunk.** Store found weapons and spare outfits in your personal vehicle.
**9. Holster in public.** Tap L1 or LB. People call the police when they see a drawn gun.

**10. Read the Heat icons.** The red icons under your wanted stars show what police know: outfit, face, car, weapon or partner. Change those things to escape. See the [wanted level guide](/guides/gta-6-wanted-level-heat/).
**11. Use Focus.** Click both sticks, L3 and R3. In a fight it slows time. Outside combat it highlights enemies, loot and usable objects.
**12. Scan cars before stealing them.** Hold Up on the D-pad for WAiNK. It shows alarms and trackers.
**13. Take a cab to travel fast.** Call a taxi from your phone and pay extra to skip the ride. See [fast travel](/guides/gta-6-fast-travel-switch-characters/).
**14. Train a little each day.** Strength raises your health and Cardio your stamina, but both fade if you stop. See the [stats guide](/guides/gta-6-strength-cardio-focus/).
**15. Mind your Criminal Profile.** Needless killing pushes it toward a permanent worst level. See [Criminal Profile](/guides/gta-6-criminal-profile/).

sections.h2: One thing to do before Chapter 1 ends
p: Some content only exists in Chapter 1. Before you start the mission Tourist Trap, check the [missable content list](/guides/gta-6-missables/) so nothing is locked out.

faqs.q: What should I do first in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Finish the Prologue, make a manual save, stash your cash under Jason's floorboards and buy a gun during the Gear Up mission.

faqs.q: Does GTA 6 have mission replay?
faqs.a: No. Keep manual saves if you want to go back.

faqs.q: How do you use Focus in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Click both sticks together: L3 and R3 on PS5, or both stick clicks on Xbox.

guides.title: GTA 6 Controls: Full PS5 and Xbox Button Layout
guides.description: Every default GTA 6 control for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S: on foot, combat, phone shortcuts and driving, plus the Classic and Left-Handed schemes.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Controls for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
guides.intro: GTA 6 changes a few controls that series veterans know by heart. The biggest is running: you no longer tap a face button to sprint. This page lists the default layout for both consoles and explains the changes worth knowing.

p: These are the Default scheme controls. PS5 buttons are listed first, with the Xbox equivalent beside them.

list: **Running is on the left stick.** Click L3 to run, and click again to sprint. There is no tap-to-sprint.
**Crouch is on Circle or B.** Hold it to rest.
**The D-pad does double duty.** A tap and a hold do different things on every direction.
**Focus is new.** Click both sticks to slow time in a fight or highlight things around you.

p: Once the story unlocks it, hold **Right on the D-pad** to open the partner menu, then press **R1** on PS5 or **RB** on Xbox to switch between Jason and Lucia. More in [fast travel and switching](/guides/gta-6-fast-travel-switch-characters/).

list: Accelerate and brake with the triggers: R2 and L2, or RT and LT.
Handbrake: Cross or A.
Shoot from the vehicle: R1 or RB.
Exit the vehicle: Triangle or Y.

p: Settings offers three schemes. **Default** is the layout above. **Classic** moves Run back to Cross or A and puts Jump on Square or X, which will feel familiar from older games. **Left-Handed** mirrors the sticks, shoulders and triggers.

Cheats use these same inputs: Up on the D-pad for the phone, then hold L1 and press R1 on PS5, or LB and RB on Xbox, and enter the arrows. See [how to enter cheats](/guides/how-to-enter-cheats-gta-6/).

data.caption: GTA 6 default controls: on foot and combat

guides.title: How to Save in GTA 6: Manual Saves and Autosave
guides.description: How to save your game in GTA 6, when autosave runs, why there is no mission replay, and a save-slot routine that protects trophies and missables.
guides.h1: How to Save in GTA 6: Manual Saves, Autosave and Slots
guides.intro: Saving matters more in GTA 6 than in earlier games, for two reasons. Autosave is limited, and there is no way to replay a finished mission. A good manual save habit is the only safety net you have.

steps: Press Options on PS5 or Menu on Xbox to pause.
Go to the **Game** tab.
Choose **Save Game** and pick a slot.
sections.after: You cannot save in the middle of a mission. Save before you start one, or after it ends.

p: Autosave runs when a mission ends. It does not run constantly while you roam, so free-roam progress since your last mission, such as collectibles, purchases and money earned, is not protected until you save by hand.
Manual saving is reported to be unavailable during the Prologue. Plan to play through it in one sitting, then make your first save as soon as the option appears.

GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. If you want to see a mission again, or you miss something that cannot be done later, the only way back is an older save. That makes a save at the start of each chapter worth the few seconds it takes.

list: **One slot per chapter.** Save at the start of each chapter and never overwrite those slots. The game is reported to offer 15 manual slots, which is plenty.
**One rolling slot.** Overwrite this one as you play.
**One slot before the final mission.**

**One cheat slot.** Using a cheat disables saving and trophies for the session, so load a separate save when you want to experiment. See [cheats, trophies and saving](/guides/gta-6-cheats-trophies-saving/).
Before Tourist Trap, the Chapter 1 point of no return. See [missable content](/guides/gta-6-missables/).
Before any rampage that could damage your [Criminal Profile](/guides/gta-6-criminal-profile/).
After banking a big score, so the money is locked in.
Before attempting a six-star survival run or other risky challenge.

faqs.q: How do you save in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Pause, open the Game tab and choose Save Game. You cannot save during a mission.

faqs.q: Does GTA 6 autosave?
faqs.a: Yes, but only when a mission ends. Free-roam progress is not autosaved, so save manually.

faqs.q: Can you replay missions in GTA 6?
faqs.a: No. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.

guides.title: GTA 6 Stats: How to Raise Strength, Cardio and Focus
guides.description: How the GTA 6 fitness system works: raise Strength for health, Cardio for stamina and Focus for slow motion, with workout windows explained.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Stats Guide: How to Increase Strength, Cardio and Focus
guides.intro: Jason and Lucia each have three stats you train yourself: Strength, Cardio and Focus. They are not cosmetic. Strength sets your maximum health, Cardio sets your stamina, and Focus decides how long you can slow time in a fight.

p: Each character trains separately, so progress on Jason does nothing for Lucia.

Strength comes from weight training. In Chapter 1 there are free weights on the terrace of Jason's house, so you can start without paying. Later, fitness studios around Leonida offer more equipment for a membership fee. Treadmills and bikes do not raise Strength. Stick to weights.

Cardio is the easiest stat to build because ordinary travel counts. Running, swimming, cycling and kayaking all train it, as do treadmills, exercise bikes and the punching bag. Cycling somewhere instead of driving is free training.

Focus grows from calm, skilled activities instead of workouts: meditation, fishing, basketball, golf, pool and shooting-range challenges. Unlike the other two, **Focus does not fade** once you have raised it, so every gain is permanent.

list: Open the **Fitness app** on your phone to see your progress and your workout windows. Train while a window is open.
**Finish the whole workout.** Quitting early loses the gains from that session.
**Eat protein afterwards.** A protein shake from the fridge, or a bar at a studio, speeds up recovery.
**Do not skip too many days.** Strength and Cardio decline if you neglect them.
**Train together.** When Jason and Lucia work out at a studio as a pair, the character you are not controlling trains too.
**Personal Best** (hidden Bronze trophy): max out Strength for both characters.
**Body Armor cheat:** complete 100 workouts. See the [Body Armor guide](/guides/gta-6-body-armor-cheat/).
**Fisheye and Fast Forward cheats:** catch 100 fish and complete 50 meditations. Both also build Focus. See [fishing and meditation](/guides/gta-6-fishing-meditation-cheats/).
After the story, the Unlimited Focus cheat removes the Focus limit entirely.
p: Log workouts, fish and meditations in the [Tracker](/tracker/) so the same sessions count toward your cheat unlocks.

data.caption: GTA 6 character stats
rows: Running, swimming, cycling, treadmill, punching bag
Meditation, fishing, basketball, golf, pool, shooting ranges

faqs.q: How do you increase health in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Raise your Strength stat with weight training. Strength sets your maximum health.

faqs.q: Where can I work out in GTA 6?
faqs.a: On the terrace of Jason's house in Chapter 1 for free, and at fitness studios for a membership fee.

faqs.q: Does Focus go down in GTA 6?
faqs.a: No. Strength and Cardio fade if you stop training, but Focus gains are kept.

guides.title: GTA 6 Fast Travel and How to Switch Characters
guides.description: How fast travel works in GTA 6 (taxis, about $100), how to switch between Jason and Lucia, and when each option unlocks in the story.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Fast Travel and How to Switch Between Jason and Lucia
guides.intro: Leonida is big, and GTA 6 does not have a fast travel menu. It does have a paid shortcut, and from Chapter 2 you can jump between its two lead characters. Here is how both work.

steps: Take out your phone with Up on the D-pad.
Call a cab.
Get in and choose your destination.
Pay the extra fee to skip the journey. It is widely reported as $100.
sections.after: That is the only fast travel in the game. There is no map-based teleport.

p: A taxi has to be able to reach you. Players report that cabs may not come to small islands, so head for the mainland or a bridge before you call. You also need the fare, so keep a little cash in hand or in your bank account.

Often you do not need a taxi at all, just your car. In Chapter 1, call Joey from your contacts to have Jason's car brought back. From Chapter 2, the Scooter Bros app delivers any registered vehicle to you for a fee. See [keeping cars](/guides/gta-6-keep-cars-register/).
Switching between Jason and Lucia unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission **Breakfast Run**. Hold **Right on the D-pad** to open the partner menu, then press **R1** on PS5 or **RB** on Xbox.

list: Each character has separate [stats](/guides/gta-6-strength-cardio-focus/) and a separate [Criminal Profile](/guides/gta-6-criminal-profile/).
Some side missions belong to one character. Andy's strand is for Lucia, while Tyrone's and Bret's are for Jason. See [Strangers and Freaks](/guides/gta-6-strangers-and-freaks/).
Splitting from your partner is also one way to clear a Heat icon when the police are looking for a pair.

p: Holding Right on the D-pad does more than switch. The same menu lets you talk to your partner and tell them to split up or take the car, which is useful during an escape. Time and activities with your partner also count toward several cheats. See [partner cheats](/guides/gta-6-partner-cheats/).

faqs.q: Is there fast travel in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Yes, by taxi. Call a cab from your phone and pay an extra fee, widely reported as $100, to skip the ride.

faqs.q: How do you switch between Jason and Lucia?
faqs.a: Hold Right on the D-pad and press R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox. This unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

faqs.q: When can you switch characters in GTA 6?
faqs.a: After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

guides.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
guides.description: GTA 6 has 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver and 46 Bronze. Every visible trophy with its requirement, plus a spoiler-light roadmap.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: All 55 and How to Earn Them
guides.intro: GTA 6 has 55 trophies on PS5: one Platinum, two Gold, six Silver and 46 Bronze. On Xbox the same list is worth 1,000 Gamerscore. Twenty-seven are visible from the start and 28 are hidden, most of them tied to the story. This page lists every visible trophy and describes the hidden ones without spoiling the plot.

p: These are shown in the trophy list from the moment you start the game.

list: **Twelve are story trophies.** They unlock as you finish chapters and major missions. One of them, for the final mission, is the second Gold. You cannot miss these by playing the story.

**Six are for side characters.** Finishing the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each gives a trophy, and Bret has one for a special hunt. See [Strangers and Freaks](/guides/gta-6-strangers-and-freaks/).

**The rest are one-off actions.** Confirmed examples include maxing Strength for both characters (Personal Best), performing 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (Actions Speak Louder), using a tank (Challenging Tank) and taking off from the airport unannounced (Catch Me If You Can). The triggers for five others are still unconfirmed.

p: **Positive Mental Attitude** asks you to meditate at every spot in Leonida. One meditation, with Lucia on the balcony of Jason's house, is only available in Chapter 1, and early guides were unsure whether it counted. Two guides now report that the trophy unlocks without it, because it is not one of the map spots. Time-limited content that is still worth protecting, such as the street race in Chapter 3, is in the [missables guide](/guides/gta-6-missables/).

steps: **Chapter 1:** keep a manual save. Lucia's balcony meditation is optional.
**From Chapter 2:** work on the partner trophies, Hot Together and Retail Therapy. Buy garages for Little Boxes once the Real Estate app arrives.
**Chapter 3:** get the Snap Gun for Sneakthief, and do the time-limited street race while it is on offer.
**Chapter 4:** take the optional mission that opens bank vaults, for Maximum Withdrawal.
**After the credits:** finish the 100% checklist, the side-character strands and the long grinds such as 250 stunts.
sections.after: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep a save at the start of each chapter. See [how to save](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/).

sections.h2: Never use cheats on your trophy save
p: Using any cheat disables trophies and saving for that session. Cheats only unlock after the story anyway, so by then most trophies are behind you. Keep a separate slot for cheating. See [cheats, trophies and saving](/guides/gta-6-cheats-trophies-saving/).

guides.title: GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks: All Side Characters
guides.description: Every Strangers and Freaks side character in GTA 6, who can play them, which strands count toward the Silver trophy and which have their own.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks: Every Side Character and Trophy
guides.intro: Strangers and Freaks are the side characters you meet across Leonida, each with a short chain of optional missions. They matter for two reasons: a Silver trophy for finishing eight of the strands, and separate trophies for several individual characters. This list is spoiler-light and sticks to who, when and what you get.

p: Side missions usually appear on the map as optional missions. Some can only be played as Jason or as Lucia.

The Silver trophy asks for **8 stranger mission strands**. Not every side character counts. Launch guides agree that Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward it. Characters who have a trophy of their own, such as Billy, Andy, Tyrone, Bret and Randy, do not. The remaining strands that count are still being confirmed as players finish the game.

list: **This Was No Boat Accident:** finish Kenton's diving strand.
**Baited My Tackle:** beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
**The Lone Rider:** finish Billy's strand.
**Fair Game:** hunt a unique animal for Bret (Jason only).
**Supply & Demand:** finish [Randy's Wish List](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/) strand.
**Road to Rehabilitation:** finish Andy's strand (Lucia only).
**Spin On This!:** finish Tyrone's strand (Jason only).

p: Three characters around the Keys open early. **Kenton** offers treasure dives after the mission Island Dreams. He has seven sets of dive sites, and five of the seven are reported to count toward 100%. His dives are also good early money. **Kirk** sends you looking for the Skunk Ape, with some missions available only at night. **Shirley**, Jason's neighbour, has two short errands that can be missed for good when Chapter 1 ends.

**Kyle** has three missions around a farm. **Billy** runs with a dirt bike crew at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, across five missions: Thrillbillies; Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab; Mall Rats; The Impaler; and Hometown Heroes. **Bret Vogel** is a hunting contact for Jason. **Moses** has ongoing car deliveries, which also unlock car registration and the Scooter Bros app.

**Yago** brings street racing. One of his races is time-limited, so do it when it appears. **Andy** has a Lucia-only strand, and **Tyrone** a Jason-only one that opens after a story mission. **Randy** opens his Wish List midway through the chapter. **Pilot Pete** offers flying jobs for Jason.

Billy's five missions are in the [Tracker](/tracker/) as an optional group, with names blurred until you tap them. For the trophies each strand feeds, see the [trophy list](/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/).
For the main cast, see the [characters guide](/guides/gta-6-characters/).

faqs.q: How many Strangers and Freaks do you need for the trophy?
faqs.a: Eight mission strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.

faqs.q: Are Billy's missions part of the main story?
faqs.a: No. Thrillbillies and the rest of Billy's missions are optional, although they first appear during Chapter 2.

faqs.q: Can you miss any side missions in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Yes. Shirley's Chapter 1 errands disappear when the chapter ends, and one of Yago's races in Chapter 3 is time-limited.

guides.title: GTA 6 Missables: Everything You Can Miss, by Chapter
guides.description: Missable content in GTA 6 by chapter: Chapter 1-only errands and meditation, stash cash, a time-limited race, and permanent choices to avoid.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Missables: What You Can Miss and When to Do It
guides.intro: GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so anything you miss stays missed unless you have an older save. The list of true missables is short, and most of it sits in Chapter 1. Here is everything to do before each point of no return, with no story spoilers.

p: The mission **Tourist Trap** is the point of no return for Chapter 1. Do these first.
list: **Get Shirley's Rum** and **Steal the Scooter:** two optional errands for Jason's neighbour, Shirley. Both are gone after Chapter 1.

**Meditate with Lucia:** an optional meditation on the balcony of Jason's house, on the morning after the mission Down to Earth. It is only offered in Chapter 1. Guides now report that it is not needed for the Positive Mental Attitude trophy or for 100%, so do it because you want to see it, not because you must.

**Move your money.** Guides report that the cash you are carrying, your BuckMe checking balance and anything under Jason's floorboards are all gone when Chapter 2 starts. Money in Family Savings carries over, and so do the guns and clothes you have bought. The [Chapter 1 checklist](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-checklist/) has the full routine.
**Use edition bonuses.** Ultimate Edition owners report that some bonus items, including a bike, a kayak and a custom build for Jason's car, are only usable in Chapter 1.
**Make a manual save** in a slot you will not overwrite.
**Yago's timed race.** One of Yago's street races is time-limited and marked with an hourglass. Do it when it appears. Yago's strand counts toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
**Errands with an hourglass icon** in general are reported to expire if you leave them, so treat that icon as a warning.

**The optional vault mission.** Bank vaults are opened by an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. You need vaults for the Maximum Withdrawal trophy, so start it before you move on. See [bank vault robberies](/guides/gta-6-bank-vault-robbery/).
**Irredeemable Criminal Profile.** The worst profile level is permanent for that character. Save before any rampage. See [Criminal Profile](/guides/gta-6-criminal-profile/).

**Your free respray.** The repair and respray at Coastal Auto Care are free during the mission Just a Scratch, and one guide notes that later repairs cost money. Guides also report that Jason's car does not carry into Chapter 2, so do not spend much on it.

p: Story trophies cannot be missed. Collectibles such as cards, Cocaine Flamingos, WAiNK scans and underwater discoveries can be collected after the credits. Challenges and cheat unlocks also stay open. If something is not on this page, you can almost certainly come back for it.

Keep one save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. That routine, described in [how to save](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/), turns every item on this list from a permanent loss into a minor detour. You can tick off chapter missions as you go in the [Tracker](/tracker/).

faqs.q: What is missable in GTA 6 Chapter 1?
faqs.a: Shirley's two errands, the balcony meditation with Lucia, and any money that is not in Family Savings. Sort them out before the mission Tourist Trap.

faqs.q: Is there a point of no return in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Yes. Tourist Trap is the point of no return for Chapter 1.

faqs.q: Can you replay missions to get missed content?
faqs.a: No. GTA 6 has no mission replay or New Game Plus, so use manual saves.

guides.title: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Checklist: What to Do Before Tourist Trap
guides.description: What to do in GTA 6 Chapter 1 before Tourist Trap: move your money, finish Jason's errands and house repairs, and see what carries into Chapter 2.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Checklist: Things to Do Before Tourist Trap
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** before you start Tourist Trap, make a manual save, empty the floorboard stash, put $5,000 into Family Savings and spend the rest on guns and clothes. Do Shirley's two errands and the balcony meditation with Lucia if you want to see them, because they are gone afterwards. Jason's house repairs and errands have an earlier deadline: finish them before the mission Coming Home. Nothing on this page spoils the story.

p: **Tourist Trap** is the point of no return. It runs straight into Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time, the last two missions of the chapter, and guides report no free roam again until Chapter 2 has begun. GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so an older save is the only way back.

Guides differ on exactly how Tourist Trap begins once the mission before it, Recalibration, is done. One says it starts on its own, and others describe a marker or a pick-up that you can delay. The safe plan is to finish this checklist and make your save **before Recalibration**. The [Chapter 1 mission list](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-missions/) shows where both sit in the order.

This is the step that costs players the most. Guides report that when Chapter 1 ends you lose the cash you are carrying, the balance in your BuckMe checking account and anything under Jason's floorboards. Moving stash money into the bank is not enough on its own.
steps: **Empty the floorboard stash** in Jason's bedroom.

**Put $5,000 into Family Savings** at an ATM. It is the savings side of the BuckMe app, which opens with the mission Buck Me, and guides report that it carries over. Two guides suggest $5,000. Guides describe Family Savings as a savings goal, not spending money, so do not put in more than you mean to.
**Spend the rest on guns and clothes.** Guides report that bought weapons, their attachments and your clothes are all kept.
**Leave Jason's car alone.** The car and its upgrades are reported not to follow you into Chapter 2.
sections.after: The [money safety guide](/guides/gta-6-keep-money-safe/) explains the stash and the bank in more detail.

list: **Get Shirley's Rum** and **Steal the Scooter.** Two errands for Jason's neighbour, Shirley. The rum comes from Three Sheets Liquor, and the scooter errand is reported to open about a day after the first one.

**Meditate with Lucia.** An optional meditation on the balcony of Jason's house, on the morning after the mission Down to Earth. Guides report that it does not count toward the Positive Mental Attitude trophy.
**Clock Out.** Lucia calls after the mission Day Release. Guides list this one as time-limited, and they say to collect her before 4 pm.

**Ring the Bell!** Cal texts Jason to meet at the Rusty Anchor. Two guides say to do it before the mission Swamped and one says it stays open afterwards, so do it early. It is reported to unlock a Rusty Anchor T-shirt and cap.
**Ultimate Edition extras.** The bonus bike, kayak and custom car build are reported to be lost when the chapter ends, so use them now.
**Small pickups inside missions.** Two guides point out cash in a trailer during Gone Fishing and a pair of sunglasses for Lucia during Day Release.
p: All of these are optional. One detailed guide reports that nothing in Chapter 1 is needed for a trophy or for 100%, so skip any that do not interest you.

sections.h2: The earlier deadline: before Coming Home
p: A second, earlier deadline catches people out. Jason can fix up the house and run a few errands before Lucia comes home, and guides report that these close with the mission **Coming Home**, well before Tourist Trap.

**House repairs.** Guides list the steps, the leaky roof, the railing and a wall that needs fixing and painting. They open as soon as free roam does, after Gone Fishing, and are reported to improve how things start between Jason and Lucia.

**Errands after Feng Shui.** Guides list groceries, flowers, a haircut, collecting Lucia's clothes and buying her a necklace. The necklace is reported to cost $475 at The Siren's Chest in south-west Key Lento.

Every row below is what guides report, not something Rockstar has published. Guides do not say whether spare ammo carries over, so do not stock up on it for that reason. The [gun shops guide](/guides/gta-6-gun-shops/) covers what to buy.

table.caption: What is reported to carry over from Chapter 1
rows: Guns you bought, and their attachments
Kept. Collected from the weapons locker at an Ammu-Nation store
Ultimate Edition bike, kayak and car build

p: Most of what you find in the Keys is not missable. Guides report that Kenton's treasure dives, fishing with Cal and the gang hideouts pause when the chapter ends and come back later. Collectibles, challenges and cheat unlocks stay open after the credits, as the [missables guide](/guides/gta-6-missables/) explains. Guides also report that you can return to the Keys during Chapter 2, though not straight away.
So there is no need to grind money or clear the map before Tourist Trap. Guides advise against farming cash in Chapter 1, since most of it is wiped.

Guides put Chapter 1 at roughly six to ten hours, depending on how much side content you do. One reviewer who did everything reports about 18 hours. The chapter has 22 main missions, and one guide counts 34 missions and tasks once the optional ones are included. Tick them off in the [Tracker](/tracker/) as you go.

sections.h2: The order to do it in
steps: After Gone Fishing, start the house repairs and make a manual save. See [how to save](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/).
Do Shirley's rum errand, then the scooter errand when it opens.
After Feng Shui, run Jason's errands and buy the necklace before Coming Home.
After Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony.
After Day Release, answer Lucia's call for Clock Out, and meet Cal before Swamped.
Before Recalibration, make a save you will not overwrite, empty the stash, fill Family Savings and spend the rest.
Start Tourist Trap when you are ready for Chapter 2.

faqs.q: What should I do before Tourist Trap in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Make a manual save, empty the floorboard stash, put $5,000 into Family Savings and spend the rest on guns and clothes. Do Shirley's two errands and the balcony meditation first if you want to see them.

faqs.q: Do you keep your money after Chapter 1 in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Guides report that only Family Savings carries over. Cash you are carrying, the BuckMe checking balance and the floorboard stash are all lost.

faqs.q: Do you keep your guns after Chapter 1 in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Guides report that guns you bought are kept, along with attachments and clothes. You collect the guns from an Ammu-Nation weapons locker in Chapter 2.

faqs.q: How long is Chapter 1 of GTA 6?
faqs.a: Guides put it at roughly six to ten hours. It has 22 main missions.

guides.title: GTA 6 Editions: Standard vs Ultimate and Pre-Order Bonuses
guides.description: What each GTA 6 edition includes: Standard and Ultimate prices, all 16 Ultimate bonuses, the Vintage Vice City pre-order pack and why there is no disc.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Editions Compared: Standard, Ultimate and Pre-Order Bonuses
guides.intro: GTA 6 is sold in two editions on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S: Standard and Ultimate. The Ultimate Edition is the base game plus a set of extra vehicles, weapons, outfits, shops and activities. This page lists what Rockstar announced for each edition, and what came with pre-orders before the game launched on 19 November 2026.

sections.h2: The two editions and their prices
p: Rockstar announced the prices in June 2026. In the United States the Standard Edition costs **$79.99** and the Ultimate Edition costs **$99.99**. UK prices were reported as £69.99 and £89.99. Check your console store for the price in your region.
Both editions are for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. There is no PC version yet. The [release date and platforms guide](/guides/gta-6-release-date-platforms/) covers that in more detail.

GTA 6 is a digital game on both consoles. The boxed edition sold in shops holds a download code, not a disc. Boxed copies went on sale on 12 November 2026, a week before launch, so that buyers could redeem the code and pre-load. Digital pre-loading began on the same day.
Rockstar listed 16 bonuses for the Ultimate Edition. They are not all handed over at the start. Coverage of the announcement says they open up at different points as the story moves on.
The two mod shops and the Stock 305 clothing store are described as open only to Ultimate Edition owners. The salon and the tattoo shop were reported the same way.
list: **Vehicles:** the '95 Grotti Cheetah sports car, the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy with its own garage, the Squalo boat, and extra vehicles at Jason's safehouse, including a Dinka Enduro motorcycle and a Crest kayak.
**Vehicle build:** the Ganado Retro Build, a set of retro modifications for Jason's Vapid Ganado pickup.
**Weapons:** Hawk & Little Morgan revolvers for Jason and Lucia, plus two personalised pistols, a Girardi ES9 for Jason and a Klose K17 for Lucia.
**Looks:** the Vice City Style outfits and tattoos, and the Goodtime Gear clothing set.
**Shops:** the mod shops Rideout Customs and One-Eyed Willie's, the Stock 305 clothing store, Sara's Unisex Salon and Electric Fang Tattoo.
**Activities:** the PTT Youngin$ Illegal Goods Store, a gang compound, and the Classic Car Collection, a set of project cars from a character named Wyman.

sections.h2: Pre-order bonus: the Vintage Vice City Pack
p: Every pre-order came with the Vintage Vice City Pack, whichever edition you chose. Pre-orders closed when the game launched. We have not been able to confirm whether the pack will be sold separately, so treat any claim about that as unconfirmed.

Digital pre-orders on the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store also included one free month of GTA+, Rockstar's subscription. It renews at the normal price unless you cancel it. Boxed pre-orders were reported not to include the free month.
list: A '55 Vapid Stanier saloon, kept in the Shore Court garage. The garage has a weapon locker and a drop-off for stolen goods you want to fence.
Vintage outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia.
A tropical pattern for most guns, a nod to Tommy Vercetti's shirt from GTA: Vice City.

p: The gap between the two editions is $20. Before launch, outlets expected a separate Ultimate upgrade for Standard owners at about that price, sold through the PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store and open to boxed copies too. We have not confirmed the current store price, so check it on your console before you buy.

The Standard Edition is the base game at the lower price. The Ultimate Edition suits players who want the extra cars, weapons and shops from the list above. We have not confirmed whether any Ultimate-only shop or item counts towards 100% completion or a trophy, so nothing on this site assumes that it does.

Whichever edition you own, the [Tracker](/tracker/) works the same way. The [garages guide](/guides/gta-6-garages/) explains how the garages that come with editions sit alongside the eight you can buy, and the [beginner tips](/guides/gta-6-beginner-tips/) cover the first hours of the game.

guides.title: GTA 6 Patch Notes: Every Update and What It Fixed
guides.description: Every GTA 6 update in one place. Update 01.002.002 arrived on 23 November 2026 with seven fixes, including autosave, weather and wanted level bugs.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Patch Notes and Update Tracker
guides.intro: Rockstar released the first GTA 6 update since launch on 23 November 2026. This page lists each update, what Rockstar says it changed and what the notes leave out. It was last checked on 28 November 2026 and will be updated when a new patch ships.

p: The update came out on **23 November 2026**, four days after launch, for both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. On PS5 it appears as version **01.002.002**. On Xbox the same update is reported as version 1.0.2.2.
The download is small. It is reported at about 604 MB on PS5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox. Those sizes come from update trackers and press coverage, not from Rockstar, so treat them as reported figures.

Rockstar published the notes on its support site later on release day. The first news reports went out before that, which is why some early articles say there were no notes. The list has seven fixes under one general heading. Rockstar gives no further detail on any of them. It does not say which crashes were fixed, for example.

The autosave fix is the one most players will care about. Coverage of the patch reported that some players had lost progress to the bug. Autosave is still no replacement for a manual save, so keep the routine from the [saving guide](/guides/gta-6-how-to-save/).

If you were stuck with a wanted level that would not clear, that bug is on the list. The normal ways to lose the police are in the [wanted level and Heat guide](/guides/gta-6-wanted-level-heat/). The deadlift bar is part of weight training, which is how you raise Strength. The [stats guide](/guides/gta-6-strength-cardio-focus/) explains how that works.
list: Several problems that made the game crash.
Weather that stayed the same for long stretches.
Autosave not saving correctly.
Phone calls that failed to start, including calls that move the story on or open up missions.
Players being unable to lose a wanted level.
The deadlift bar at the gym not working.
Partners not handing over bags, which stopped you from selling them to a fence.

sections.h2: What the notes do not mention
p: None of the seven fixes mentions cheats, prices or payouts. The cheat codes on this site were re-checked on 28 November 2026, after the patch. The 21 codes listed before it still match what other outlets show, and the other 40 have been added since. See the [full cheats list](/guides/gta-6-all-cheats-list/) for the current state.

The notes are short, and they name only the seven items above. If a problem you have is not on the list, assume it is still open until Rockstar says otherwise. We will not list a fix here unless the published notes include it.

On PS5 the update did not reach everyone at once. Trackers reported three stages: about a third of players at first, about two thirds three hours later, and everyone after about six hours. Rockstar did not announce the staging itself. Sources differ on whether the stages went by region or by share of players.
No staging was reported for Xbox.
Both consoles normally download game updates on their own when they are online. If yours has not, you can ask for it by hand.
steps: On PS5, highlight GTA 6 on the home screen, press the Options button and choose Check for Update.
On Xbox Series X|S, open My games & apps, choose Manage, then Updates.
sections.after: Game updates do not affect your [Tracker](/tracker/) progress, which is stored in your browser.

p: Two builds were reported before launch, during the pre-load period: 01.002.000 on 13 November 2026 and 01.002.001 on 16 November 2026. Rockstar published no notes for either, so there is nothing confirmed to list for them. The [release date guide](/guides/gta-6-release-date-platforms/) covers the pre-load dates.

guides.title: GTA 6 Meditation Spots: All 10 Locations and 18 Meditations
guides.description: All 10 GTA 6 meditation spots and how they make 18 meditations: where each one is, when the last one appears and what you get for finishing them.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Meditation Spots: All 10 Locations
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** GTA 6 has 10 meditation spots that add up to 18 meditations. One is a lesson at Jason's house in Chapter 1. Eight are out in the open world and count once each for Jason and Lucia. The last one is on top of Mount Kalaga and only appears when the rest are done. Guides report that 15 of the 18 are enough for 100% completion. Nothing on this page spoils the story.

p: Guides that list every spot agree on 10 locations. The first is a lesson with Lucia at Jason's house, and it counts once. The next eight are open-world spots. Each of those counts twice, once when Jason meditates there and once when Lucia does. The tenth, called Ascent, counts once. That gives 1 + 16 + 1 = 18.
One guide numbers them as 18 spots instead of 10 places. It describes the same locations in the same order, so the two ways of counting match.

table.caption: How the 18 meditations are counted
rows: Eight open-world spots, Jason and Lucia once each

p: Meditation opens in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate at Jason's house. Guides say to aim at her with L2 on PS5 or LT on Xbox and choose Accept to join her. Finishing the lesson counts as your first meditation.

The lesson is only on offer during Chapter 1, and guides differ on what happens if you skip it. One early trophy guide says the trophy is then out of reach. A more detailed guide reports that the lesson is not needed for the trophy or for 100%, and that a replacement lesson is marked on the map from Chapter 2 for players who missed it. The safe choice is to do it in Chapter 1. The [Chapter 1 checklist](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-checklist/) lists everything else that closes with the chapter.
The names are the ones guides use for each spot. Each place in the table is supported by at least two guides. The county is left out where guides give different ones.
One guide warns that the Waterfall spot is on a rock in the river and is awkward to reach on foot. It recommends a helicopter for that spot, for the sandbar and for the mountain top.

sections.h2: How to find spots on the map
p: You do not need to memorise the table. Guides report that a spot shows up as a purple icon on the map once you are close to it, and that the Exploration filter on the map has an entry called Meditate Around Leonida. Your running total is under Progress, then Collections, Exploration and Meditations. The [Progress menu guide](/guides/gta-6-progress-menu/) explains the other cards.

Each open-world spot has to be visited by both characters to earn both of its meditations. The full run is easiest once you can [switch between Jason and Lucia](/guides/gta-6-fast-travel-switch-characters/), which opens in Chapter 2. One trophy guide suggests waiting until Chapter 3, when more of the map is easy to reach.

Every guide agrees on Ascent. It is on the summit of Mount Kalaga in Lummox County, and it does not appear on the map until the other meditations are finished. One guide adds that it takes a short while to show up after the last of them, so do not worry if the icon is not there at once. Finishing Ascent completes the set.

list: **Positive Mental Attitude.** A Bronze trophy for meditating at every spot in Leonida. See the [trophy list](/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/).
**100% completion.** Three guides report that 15 of the 18 meditations are enough. See the [100% checklist](/guides/gta-6-100-percent-completion/).

**Fast Forward.** The [Fast Forward](/cheats/fast-forward/) filter cheat unlocks after 50 meditations. Repeats count, so you will go back to spots you have already used. The [fishing and meditation guide](/guides/gta-6-fishing-meditation-cheats/) covers the pacing.
**Focus.** Meditation is one of the activities that raises the [Focus stat](/guides/gta-6-strength-cardio-focus/).
p: Tick spots off in the [Tracker](/tracker/) as you go. It has one counter for meditation spots and another for total meditations.

faqs.q: How many meditation spots are in GTA 6?
faqs.a: 10 locations that add up to 18 meditations. Eight of the locations count twice, once for Jason and once for Lucia.

faqs.q: Where is the last meditation spot in GTA 6?
faqs.a: On the summit of Mount Kalaga in Lummox County. It is called Ascent, and it only appears once the other meditations are done.

faqs.q: Can you miss a meditation spot in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Only the Chapter 1 lesson at Jason's house can be missed. Recent guides report that it is not needed for the trophy or for 100%, but one early guide says it is, so do it if you can.

faqs.q: Do you need all 18 meditations for 100%?
faqs.a: Guides report that 15 of the 18 are enough for 100% completion. The Positive Mental Attitude trophy asks for every spot.

guides.description: Who is who in GTA 6 without story spoilers: Jason and Lucia, Brian and the Keys crew, Moses, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan, Real Dimez, Raul and Randy.
guides.h1: GTA 6 Characters: Who Is Who in Leonida
guides.intro: **Quick answer:** you play as Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a couple trying to build a better life in the state of Leonida. Around them are Brian Heder and his crew in the Keys, a new set of faces in Chapter 2, and Vice City names such as Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez and Raul Bautista. This page says who each person is and where you meet them. It stops at introductions, so there are no twists, endings or late-game names here.

p: **Jason Duval** grew up around small-time crooks, spent time in the Army and ended up in the Leonida Keys working for local drug runners. When the story opens he lives in a house that belongs to his boss, Brian.
**Lucia Caminos** begins the story in prison, where she landed while trying to look after her family. Getting out is her fresh start, and she wants more from life than scraping by.

The two are partners in work and in life. Chapter 1 is reported to be mostly Jason's, and from Chapter 2 you can [switch between them](/guides/gta-6-fast-travel-switch-characters/). Each has separate [stats](/guides/gta-6-strength-cardio-focus/), and some side missions belong to only one of them.

sections.h2: Chapter 1: Brian's circle in the Keys
list: **Brian Heder.** A veteran drug runner who moves his product through a boat yard in the Keys. He is Jason's landlord and gives him work.
**Lori Heder.** Brian's third wife, who runs the boat yard with him.
**Cal Hampton.** Jason's friend, who also works for Brian. He is the one to see about [fishing](/guides/gta-6-fishing-meditation-cheats/).
**Donnie.** A pilot who flies drops for Brian.
**Kenton Rees.** A treasure hunter who sends Jason diving on wrecks. His dives open after the mission Island Dreams.
**Andy.** Lucia's close friend, who has been keeping her clothes while she was away. Andy has a Lucia-only side strand later on.
**Mattia and Kat.** Kat shared a cell with Lucia, and Mattia is her wealthy boyfriend. They arrive with an offer of work.
**Joey.** The mechanic at Coastal Auto Care. He fixes Jason's car in the mission Just a Scratch and can bring it back to you during Chapter 1.
**Shirley Baker.** Jason's neighbour. Her two short errands are only available in Chapter 1, as the [Chapter 1 checklist](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-checklist/) explains.
**Mandy.** One of Brian's tenants.

p: You meet all five in Chapter 2, while Jason and Lucia are living out of a motel.
list: **Vicki.** A dancer who lives at the same motel.
**Dunk.** A local contact who helps Lucia get hold of painkillers.

**Moses "Mo" Watkins.** A mechanic in Port Gellhorn who buys stolen cars and makes it possible to register cars of your own. See [selling cars](/guides/gta-6-sell-cars/) and [the best cars to sell to Moses](/guides/gta-6-best-cars-to-sell-to-moses/).
**Billy.** Leads a dirt bike crew at the Thrillbilly Mud Club and has five optional missions.
**Bret Vogel.** A hunting contact for Jason. One character guide describes him as an old Army friend.

sections.h2: Chapter 3 onwards: the names Rockstar introduced
p: Rockstar introduced all four on its own website before launch, so their set-up is not a spoiler. Guides place the move to Vice City in Chapter 3.
list: **Boobie Ike.** A Vice City businessman with money in property, a strip club and a recording studio.
**Dre'Quan Priest.** A former dealer turned music executive. He runs the label Only Raw Records with Boobie.
**Real Dimez.** The rap duo Bae-Luxe and Roxy, old friends who are signed to Only Raw Records.
**Raul Bautista.** An experienced bank robber who is always looking for new people for bigger jobs.

sections.h2: Vice City: dealers, buyers and racers
list: **Randy Kozlov.** A car dealer who buys stolen high-end cars. His list of wanted cars is covered in [Randy's Wish List](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list/) and [Randy's cars](/guides/gta-6-randys-wish-list-cars/).
**Tyrone Russo.** A dealer with a Jason-only side strand.
**Yago Jiménez.** A street racer who brings racing missions.
p: Kirk, Kyle McKittrick, Pilot Pete and the other side characters have short optional strands of their own. [Strangers and Freaks](/guides/gta-6-strangers-and-freaks/) lists them, who can play each one and which trophies they feed.
Characters who first appear in Chapters 4 and 5 are left out. So are the story's villains and any faces from earlier GTA games. With those, even a name gives something away.

This page also does not list voice actors. The full cast is on Rockstar's credits page, and one outlet's copy of that list is reported to run to about 200 named roles. If you want the story beats in order, the [Chapter 1](/guides/gta-6-chapter-1-missions/) and [Chapter 2](/guides/gta-6-chapter-2-missions/) mission lists are the place to start.

faqs.q: Who are the main characters in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Both are playable, and you can switch between them from Chapter 2.

faqs.q: Who is Randy in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Randy Kozlov is a Vice City car dealer who buys stolen high-end cars. His Wish List opens in Chapter 3.

faqs.q: Who is Brian in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Brian Heder is a long-time drug runner in the Keys. He is Jason's landlord and gives him work in Chapter 1.

faqs.q: Who are Real Dimez in GTA 6?
faqs.a: A rap duo, Bae-Luxe and Roxy, signed to Only Raw Records in Vice City.

faqs.q: Does this page have spoilers?
faqs.a: No. It covers who each character is when you first meet them and leaves out the later chapters.
